Kitap dünyasına açılan kapınızı aralayın! En sevdiğiniz kitapları indirimli fiyatlarla keşfedin ve hayal gücünüzü genişletin.
Birleşmiş Milletler 'e (BM) bağlı Uluslararası Adalet Divanı (UAD), Myanmar ordusunun 2016-2017 yıllarında Arakanlı Müslümanlara (Rohingya) yönelik operasyonlarının soykırım niteliği taşıdığına karar verdi.
Hollanda'nın Lahey kentinde 19 Kasım'da açıklanan kararla birlikte UAD, tarihinde ilk kez bir devleti doğrudan soykırım işlemekten sorumlu tuttu.
The Guardian 'ın aktardığına göre, mahkemenin 15 yargıcından dokuzu Myanmar'ın Soykırım Sözleşmesi'ni ihlal ettiği sonucuna ulaştı.
Mahkeme Başkanı Yuji Iwasawa , kararın açıklanması sırasında, Myanmar'ın ülkedeki Arakanlı Müslüman nüfusun önemli bir bölümünü yok etme kastıyla hareket ettiğinin tespit edildiğini söyledi.
Myanmar ordusunun 2016 ve 2017 yıllarında ülkenin batısındaki Arakan eyaletinde düzenlediği operasyonlar, yüz binlerce insanın Bangladeş'e sığınmasına yol açtı.
Çoğunluğu Müslüman olan 700 binden fazla Arakanlı, sınırı geçerek Bangladeş'e kaçmak zorunda kaldı.
Hayatta kalanlar, askerlerin sivilleri topluca öldürdüğünü, kadınlara sistematik cinsel şiddet uyguladığını, çocukların katledildiğini ve köylerin ateşe verildiğini anlattı.
The Guardian'ın 2017 yılında görüştüğü görgü tanıkları, Tula Toli köyünde sivillerin sistematik biçimde kurşuna dizildiğini, toplu mezarlar oluşturulduğunu ve çocukların nehirde boğulduğunu aktardı.
Daha sonra elde edilen uydu görüntüleri, köyün yakılarak büyük ölçüde yok edildiğini ortaya koydu.
Bugün bir milyondan fazla Arakanlı Müslüman Bangladeş'teki mülteci kamplarında yaşamını sürdürüyor. Myanmar'da kalan Arakanlı nüfusun ise 600 binin altında olduğu tahmin ediliyor.
Mahkemenin kararı, uluslararası hukuk açısından özellikle önemli bir noktaya dayanıyor: Soykırım kastının tespit edilmesi.
1948 tarihli BM Soykırım Sözleşmesi 'ne göre bir eylemin soykırım sayılabilmesi için yalnızca kitlesel öldürmelerin veya ağır insan hakları ihlallerinin yaşanması yeterli değil.
Bir ulusal, etnik, ırksal veya dini grubun tamamını ya da bir bölümünü yok etmeye yönelik özel kastın da kanıtlanması gerekiyor.
Myanmar yönetimi, operasyonların silahlı Arakanlı gruplara karşı yürütülen meşru terörle mücadele faaliyetleri olduğunu savunuyordu.
Mahkeme, Myanmar ordusunun eylemlerinin yalnızca silahlı militanları hedef almadığına, Arakanlı nüfusun önemli bir bölümünü yok etmeye yönelik bir niyet taşıdığına hükmetti.
Kararın dikkat çeken bölümlerinden biri, Myanmar ordusunun kadınlara yönelik sistematik cinsel şiddet uygulamalarına ilişkin değerlendirmesi oldu.
Uluslararası hukuk uzmanlarına göre bu tespit, gelecekteki soykırım davaları açısından önemli bir emsal oluşturabilir.
Soykırım Sözleşmesi, hedef alınan topluluk içinde doğumları engellemeye yönelik önlemleri de soykırım kapsamına alıyor.
Mahkeme, Myanmar ordusunun cinsel şiddeti Arakanlı kadınların fiziksel ve psikolojik sağlığını bozmak, topluluğun yeniden çoğalma kapasitesini zayıflatmak amacıyla kullandığı sonucuna ulaştı.
Kararda, Arakanlı ailelerin çocuk sayısını ikiyle sınırlandıran uygulamalara da dikkat çekildi.
UAD Başkanı Iwasawa, iki saatten uzun süren karar açıklamasında Myanmar'ın mağdurların zararlarını gidermesi gerektiğini belirtti.
Mahkeme, Arakanlıların evlerine güvenli biçimde geri dönmesine izin verilmesi, el konulan veya yok edilen mülklerin iadesi ya da tazmin edilmesi ve mağdurlara fiziksel ve psikolojik rehabilitasyon sağlanması gerektiğine dikkat çekti.
Karar, Arakanlıların uluslararası hukuk bakımından ayrı bir etnik grup olarak tanınması açısından da önem taşıyor.
Myanmar yönetimi, uzun yıllardır Arakanlı Müslümanları ülkenin yerli halklarından biri olarak kabul etmiyor, onları Bangladeş kökenli yabancı göçmenler olarak nitelendiriyordu.
UAD kararları hukuken bağlayıcı olsa da mahkemenin bunları doğrudan uygulamaya koyabilecek bir yaptırım gücü bulunmuyor.
Bununla birlikte karar, yeni yaptırımların gündeme gelmesine ve diplomatik baskıların artmasına zemin hazırlayabilir.
Kararın ardından İngiltere Dışişleri Bakanı Ed Miliband, Myanmar'ın savunma ataşesinin ülkeden sınır dışı edileceğini açıkladı.
Miliband ayrıca BM Güvenlik Konseyi'nin acilen toplanması çağrısında bulundu.
Myanmar ordusunun 2016-2017 yıllarındaki operasyonlarını yöneten Min Aung Hlaing hakkında ise Uluslararası Ceza Mahkemesi (UCM) nezdinde insanlığa karşı suç iddiaları kapsamında yürütülen ayrı bir süreç bulunuyor.
UAD devletlerin uluslararası hukuktan doğan sorumluluğunu değerlendirirken UCM bireylerin cezai sorumluluğunu ele alıyor.
Min Aung Hlaing, 2021'de seçilmiş hükümete karşı askerî darbe düzenlemiş, ardından ülke on binlerce kişinin yaşamını yitirdiği bir iç savaşa sürüklenmişti.
Myanmar hakkındaki hükmün en önemli uluslararası sonuçlarından biri, Güney Afrika'nın İsrail'e karşı açtığı Gazze soykırımı davası açısından oluşturabileceği hukuki emsal.
The Guardian'a göre İsrail ve en yakın müttefiki ABD, Myanmar davasının sonucunu yakından izliyordu.
İsrail, Gazze'deki askerî operasyonlarının terörle mücadele kapsamında yürütüldüğünü savunuyor.
Myanmar davasında ise UAD, devletin terörle mücadele gerekçesinin, soykırım kastına ilişkin kanıtları geçersiz kılmadığı sonucuna ulaştı.
Bu değerlendirme, Gazze davasında da devletin açıklanan askerî amaçları ile fiilî eylemlerinin birlikte incelenmesi bakımından önem taşıyabilir.
Ancak Myanmar kararı, İsrail hakkındaki davanın sonucunu önceden belirlemiyor. Her iki dava, kendi delilleri ve hukuki koşulları çerçevesinde değerlendirilecek.
ABD Dışişleri Bakanlığı, UAD kararının sonuçlarını değerlendirmek üzere inceleme yapacağını açıkladı.
Washington, Soykırım Sözleşmesi'nin doğru yorumlanmasının önemli olduğunu belirtirken mahkemenin siyasallaştırılmaması gerektiğini savundu.
ABD yönetimi ayrıca Myanmar'daki Arakanlı Müslümanlara ve diğer azınlıklara yönelik devam eden insan hakları ihlallerinden ciddi endişe duyduğunu bildirdi.
Öte yandan Donald Trump yönetiminin uluslararası yargı kurumlarıyla yaşadığı gerilim, kararın diplomatik yansımalarına ilişkin tartışmaları artırdı.
UAD daha önce 1990'lı yıllarda Balkanlar'da işlenen suçlarla ilgili davalara bakmıştı.
Mahkeme, Srebrenitsa katliamında soykırım işlendiğini kabul etmiş, ancak Sırbistan'ın doğrudan soykırım işlediğine hükmetmemişti. Bunun yerine Sırbistan'ı soykırımı önleme ve failleri cezalandırma yükümlülüklerini ihlal etmekten sorumlu tutmuştu.
Myanmar kararı ise bir devletin doğrudan soykırım işlediğinin UAD tarafından tespit edilmesi bakımından ilk örnek olarak kayıtlara geçti.
Kararın yalnızca Arakanlı Müslümanların adalet arayışı için değil, uluslararası mahkemelerin gelecekte soykırım suçunu nasıl değerlendireceği açısından da uzun vadeli sonuçlar doğurması bekleniyor.

AI startup and Claude chatbot maker became one of the world’s most valuable publicly traded businesses with final share price of $97
Anthropic’s historic stock market debut: key takeaways, and what comes next for the AI industry
Anthropic closed its first day of trading on the US stock market about 17% higher than its initial public offering price. At the close of market on Thursday, Anthropic shares were trading at just over $97 with a nearly $1.3tn total market capitalization, $1.75tn fully diluted.
While the final share value was higher than the IPO price of $83, it marked a dip from an early high of $111.50. The firm’s shares initially soared 34% when trading got under way on its US market debut on Thursday, valuing the company at more than $2tn. Nonetheless, Anthropic’s ranked among the biggest stock market flotations in history. The artificial intelligence startup, founded in 2021, became one of the most valuable publicly traded businesses in the world.
“Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing,” said Anthropic’s chief executive, Dario Amodei , who rang the Nasdaq opening bell.
Anthropic announced late on Wednesday that it had sold 980m shares to underwriters, an upsized offering that raised $81.3bn, surpassing the previous record set by SpaceX’s initial $75bn fundraise in June.
US stocks slumped at the end of trading, a potential sign that Anthropic’s mammoth IPO wasn’t enough to alleviate concerns over the AI industry’s volatility. Most of the major chipmakers’ stock prices closed the day lower than they started. While Nvidia hit its sixth day of losses after its latest earnings call, other players like Micron and Broadcom also saw their share prices decline.
The company’s listing serves as a bellwether for the multitrillion-dollar artificial intelligence boom as the first frontier lab to be publicly traded. Wall Street investors and the entire global tech industry are watching closely how it fares on the public market.
Anthropic’s stock market debut makes it the first firm focused entirely on AI “uncluttered by an ad business or a rocket business” to be publicly traded, analysts at Yorkville Ives said.
“Anthropic’s IPO is a big near-term win for the tech sector and should help restore some investor confidence that the AI Revolution growth thesis is not waning,” Yorkville Ives analysts wrote in a memo.
The company has seen explosive growth in revenue every year of its existence – sometimes more than 1,000% – according to its investor prospectus, filed at the end of October. Anthropic brought in $16.2bn in the first six months of 2026, up from $4.6bn in revenue for all of 2025.
“You’ve seen an astronomical growth rate in terms of the top line,” said Evan Schlossman, a principal at Neostellar , a publicly traded venture capital firm. “The question investors are going to be looking at leading up to the IPO, and once it’s public, is what happens to that growth rate.”
Anthropic has also lost an enormous amount of money. In the first half of 2026, the company reported losses of $80bn, though that was largely due to a one-off charge. Losses grew to $104bn in the first nine months of 2026. The firm expects its costs to balloon as it works to secure more compute, which refers to the processing and computational power provided by arrays of semiconductor chips often located in datacenters. It is the resource that powers generative artificial intelligence and Anthropic’s single largest expense, about $18.8bn in the first nine months of 2026.
“The development of frontier AI models requires substantial investments of compute resources, capital, and human capital to conduct large-scale training runs that may span weeks or months and cost many millions of dollars,” the company’s executives wrote in the prospectus.
Anthropic has disclosed in great detail all the ways its AI models may pose a danger to humanity – including being used to develop bioweapons or deepen repression around the world. Amodei has called for a slowdown on the development of the most advanced AI models after employees expressed concerns that the companies were building them irresponsibility.
The company beat competitors like OpenAI to launching on the US stock market. However, the IPO comes amid uncertainty as the industry braces for any additional impact or fallout from the recent Nvidia scandal that led to the resignation of its founder and chief executive, Jensen Huang.
There is “huge volatility in the market”, and investors are going to be looking at how sustainable the company’s AI growth is, said Schlossman. Investors are also keen to see how important Anthropic will be in the larger AI ecosystem. The company has focused primarily on enterprise customers rather than individual consumers. Anthropic’s Claude code product has proved popular with software engineers.

Myanmar'da 2021'de yapılan askeri darbe sonrası ülkede işlenen savaş suçları, insanlığa karşı suçlar ve soykırım suçları gibi ihlalleri inceleyen ve sorumluların yargılanmasını sağlamak amacıyla faaliyet gösteren Londra merkezli MAP'ın kurucusu ve direktörü Gunness, UAD'nin Myanmar'ın Arakanlı Müslümanlara (Rohingya) yönelik soykırım işlediğine hükmettiği kararını AA muhabirine değerlendirdi.
İlk kez Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) üyesi bir devletin UAD tarafından soykırım yapmaktan suçlu bulunduğunu söyleyen Gunness, Myanmar'ın soykırımdan yargılandığı davanın Nazi savaş suçlularının yargılandığı Nuremberg mahkemelerinde görülen davalara eşdeğer öneme sahip olduğunu vurguladı.
Gunness, dava sonucunda Myanmar'a yüklenen sorumluluğun büyük olduğunu belirterek "Myanmar'ın el koyduğu, yok ettiği ve yaktığı malları sahiplerine iade etmesi, yapamıyorsa tazminat ödemesi gerekiyor. Müslümanlara öldürülen yakınlarını bulmaları ve İslam inancına göre defnetmeleri için yardım etmek zorunda. Ailelerin bir araya gelmesini sağlamak zorunda." dedi.
UAD'nin Myanmar'a getirdiği sorumlulukların bir "alışveriş listesi" gibi uzun olduğunu dile getiren Gunness, "(Myanmar'ın) İki yıl içinde neler yaptığıyla ilgili rapor vermesi gerekiyor. Yapmazlarsa bizi ilginç gelişmeler bekliyor. Çünkü bunları yapmalarının önünde pratik problemler var." diye konuştu.
Myanmar Devlet Başkanı Min Aung Hlaing mahkeme kararlarını kabul etmeme ihtimaline değinen Gunness, "Hlaing, kararları kabul etmediği takdirde aralarında ABD, Çin ve Rusya'nın da bulunduğu Soykırım Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları kararlara uyulması için baskı yapmak için hangi önlemlerin alınacağını değerlendirmek zorunda kalacak." ifadesini kullandı.
Gunness, sözleşmenin imzacılarının sözleşmeye uyulduğundan emin olmak zorunda olduğunun altını çizerek "Burada Myanmar'a baskı olarak öncelikle ekonomik yaptırımlar uygulanması ve Myanmar ordusuna askeri malzeme satışının durdurulması geliyor." değerlendirmesini yaptı.
Gunness, Arakanlı Müslümanlara yönelik soykırımın hala devam ettiğine dikkati çekerek "Soykırım hiç durmadı. Hala Rohingya halkını, pazar alanlarını, hastaneleri, okulları ve her türlü sivil altyapıyı hava saldırılarıyla vurmaya devam ediyorlar. Sözleşmenin imzacılarının soykırımı önlemek kadar cezalandırma sorumluluğu da bulunuyor." dedi.
Soykırım sorumlularını cezalandırma görevinin öncelikle Myanmar devletine düştüğünü söyleyen Gunness, "Özellikle Hlaing'in adı mahkeme başkanı tarafından özellikle anıldı. (Myanmar) Öncelikle Hlaing'in peşine düşmek zorunda." diye konuştu.
Myanmar'ın sorumluları cezalandırmadığı takdirde BM üyelerinin üzerine bir görev düştüğünü ifade eden Gunness, soykırımda parmağı bulunanların uluslararası bir mahkemede yargılanması yönünde beklenti bulunduğunu aktardı.
Bu noktadan önce Myanmar'ın tepkisini görmek gerektiğine işaret eden Gunness, Arakanlı Müslümanların güvenli bir geri dönüş yönündeki beklentilerine de değindi.
Gunness, UAD'nin geri dönüşlerin sağlanması yönünde de kararı bulunduğunu hatırlatarak Bangladeş, Çin ve Hindistan'a sığınan Arakanlıların bu ülkelerde zorlu şartlarda yaşadığını ve geri dönüş için beklediğini kaydetti.
Güneydoğu Asya Uluslar Birliği (ASEAN) üyelerine de önemli bir görev düştüğünü söyleyen Gunness, "ASEAN üyelerinin de angajmana girme politikası sona ermek zorunda. Çünkü Mahkemenin bu yasa dışı durumu destekleme riski bulunan angajmana girmeme konusundaki kararı çok net. Ekonomik, askeri ve diplomatik işbirliği sona ermeli. ASEAN (Myanmar'la) tüm ilişkileri kesmeli." ifadelerini kullandı.
Aynı zamanda BM Yakın Doğu'daki Filistinli Mültecilere Yardım ve Bayındırlık Ajansının (UNRWA) eski sözcüsü olan Gunness, Myanmar hakkında verilen kararın Güney Afrika'nın İsrail'e karşı açtığı soykırım davası açısından da önemli olduğunu söyledi.
Myanmar davasında Mahkemenin soykırıma teşvik suçu ve sivil kayıpların boyutuna yönelik yaptığı değerlendirmelerin İsrail'e yönelik soykırım suçlamalarıyla da ilgili olabileceğini belirten Gunness, "Myanmar hükümeti, soykırımı isyanı bastırmak olarak nitelendirmeye çalıştı ancak UAD hakimleri, sivil kayıpların boyutlarını göstererek bunun bir isyanı bastırma girişimi olamayacağını söyledi. İsrail'in öldürdüğünü belirttiği Hamas üyelerinin sayısının öldürülen sivil sayıları karşısında ne kadar küçük olduğu ortada." ifadelerini kullandı.
Gunness, Myanmar davasının İsrail'e karşı açılan dava için emsal teşkil edebileceğinin de altını çizerek "İsrail'e karşı dava açan avukatlar, Myanmar davasının yüzlerce sayfalık karar metnini kelime kelime okuyacak ve İsrail'in Filistinlilere karşı soykırım işlediğini göstermek için bunu emsal olarak kullanacaktır." diye konuştu.
Anadolu Ajansı web sitesinde, AA Haber Akış Sistemi (HAS) üzerinden abonelere sunulan haberler, özetlenerek yayımlanmaktadır. Abonelik için lütfen iletişime geçiniz.

texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3x2:
Anthropic has become one of the most valuable public companies in the world after its shares began trading on the stock market, taking its valuation to roughly $1.76 trillion (£1.34 trillion).
The artificial intelligence (AI) company's Thursday debut on the Nasdaq stock exchange was a crucial test for the industry, given the huge amount of money being poured into advancing the technology.
Anthropic's shares flew past its allocation price of $83 each , showing there was plenty of excitement around AI.
Yet the company, which is behind AI chatbot Claude, will remain under intense scrutiny in the months ahead to answer the key question surrounding AI: is it all worth it?
In just a few hours of trading, Anthropic's stock seemed to show that investors remain uncertain of where exactly AI is heading. The share price rose immediately to $111.53, sending the company's market value to almost $2 trillion, before falling by the end of the day as the shares closed at $97.17.
Some investors said Anthropic's debut seemed to be a success, as shares rose roughly 17% during the day, but the broader tech market did not perform as well.
The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index closed down nearly 2.3%. Stocks fell in the largest tech firms, including Google's parent company Alphabet, which was down by 2.9%, while Amazon lost almost 3.9%.
The buildout happening around this era of AI is among the most expensive endeavours in the history of technology, with more than $1 trillion being spent in the last year alone by a handful of major tech companies.
The speed at which investment has grown has led to ongoing concerns of a financial bubble.
"Bubbles don't burst on the day of the largest deal," Richard Whittle, an economist with the University of Salford said. "They burst later, if the positive future becomes suspect."
Anthropic has made one of the fastest trips from start up to IPO in history
While the basics of the technology have been around for decades, the more recent advent of more powerful computers and related components have allowed the processing of more data than ever.
The result has been AI chatbots that simulate human speech and operate tasks like software coding, digital image generation, and searching the internet more quickly.
It represents a new way of using computers that has led to the rapid rise of Anthropic, which started just five years ago and is best known as the maker of the popular AI chatbot Claude.
As the first purely AI company to go public, Anthropic will almost certainly see significant swings in price on the stock market going forward, according to Ben Barringer, who leads technology research at Quilter Cheviot.
The "initial exuberance" will wear off, Barringer said, pointing to what happened with SpaceX earlier this year.
That company, led by Elon Musk, saw shares jump by about 10% on the first day of trading, taking the company to a record-breaking valuation of $2.2 trillion.
Within a month shares had fallen below their debut price, and have mostly fallen further since.
Most tech companies see their shares fall after hitting the stock market, often after reporting quarterly results for the first time.
But many such companies, including Meta, Amazon and Google, have gone on to become the largest and most profitable corporations in the world.
With Anthropic, investors are not only looking at a notable tech company with a major valuation, and a potentially big future in business, but a company that is the first of its kind on the stock market.
"There's no obvious peer to compare it to," Neil Wilson, an investor strategist at Saxo UK, said.
Simon Jack: Can Anthropic's record-breaking IPO stop the AI bubble bursting?
So, as individual investors and even researchers and investors at large funds ask themselves if Anthropic is really worth more than $1.7 trillion, or even more, there will be few answers available.
"We'll have a stab at it," Wilson said. "I don't think anyone really knows."
A few things will likely impact the company's success on the stock market in the near-term.
One of those things is the prospect of new laws governing the use of AI tools. In the US, where Anthropic is based, Democrats will be in many more positions of power come 2027, and several politicians have already said they will be looking to ensure AI tools are safe and have some guardrails attached.
Such regulation is currently unlikely at the federal level. US President Donald Trump on Thursday spoke about AI during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China, alongside Chinese and Russian counterparts, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin.
Trump reiterated his position against "any form of robust regulation" around the technology, adding, "we won't allow that to happen, frankly."
The same day, however, a bipartisan group of US lawmakers formed the House AI Safety and Innovation Caucus, which will work specifically on AI regulation and safety considerations.
A significant driver of this kind of scrutiny is Anthropic itself. Company executives, including co-founder and CEO Dario Amodei, have been outspoken in their purported fears that future AI tools will become so capable they will outsmart humans, to the point where extinction is possible.
Anthropic has always put itself forward in public as an AI company that takes the safety of its technology very seriously.
Daniela Amodei, Anthropic's president and sister of Dario Amodei, boasted on Thursday that the company "had an AI safety team before we launched our first product".
Despite the company's claims that the technology it is building at a rapid pace could be dangerous, Anthropic has made one of the quickest trips from start-up to IPO in history.
Anthropic raises $81bn in record-breaking stock market debut

From premature baby to social media star - Famed Cincinnati Zoo hippo Fiona dies
The Cincinnati Zoo in Ohio says its beloved hippopotamus Fiona has died just days after swallowing a knitted hat that slipped into her enclosure.
"It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency," the zoo said on Thursday afternoon.
Fiona, who became a social media star after her premature birth in 2017, swallowed the hat about 10 days ago and required emergency care.
The vet staff "tried everything they could to help her" but "it was ultimately too much to overcome", the zoo said.
Fiona initially seemed fine after swallowing the hat more than a week ago
"We are in shock at the moment," Cincinnati Zoo director Dave Jenike said in a statement. "We did not expect this outcome. She fought until she couldn't anymore."
Michelle Curley, a spokesperson for the zoo, had said that the hat got into Fiona's enclosure by accident, after a visitor tossed it in the air and it caught on a ceiling fan that flung it through a small opening.
"We probably couldn't make [it] happen again if we tried," Curley said.
While she seemed fine at first, her appetite started to decrease a few days later, and the zoo staff tried to encourage Fiona to eat to help push the hat through her digestive system.
An ultrasound before her death showed the hat passing through Fiona's small intestine. A zookeeper said surgery was not an option for full-grown hippos and "our best chance for success with Fiona would be if she could pass this on her own".
The zoo also tried a different approach to attempt to get the hat to pass by encouraging Fiona to stand on a vibration plate platform borrowed from a local horse farm.
"Our animal care team was heroic in their efforts to save her. They did everything possible, but her body couldn't fight anymore," Jenike said.
Fiona was born premature at the Cincinnati Zoo in 2017 and at first struggled to survive. At birth, she weighed 13 kg (29 lbs), which the zoo said was about half the previous lowest recorded birth weight for her species.
Her death is also very premature, with hippos normally living up to 50 years in human care, according to the zoo.
"Although this was not an intentional incident, of which, regrettably, there are many, Fiona's painful death is a tragic reminder that everyone should behave carefully and respectfully around animals," said Debbie Metzler, the managing director of captive wildlife for the animal rights group People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (Peta).
"Peta expects that the zoo will review its protocols to help prevent anything like this from happening again, and we urge every visitor to secure their belongings and never toss objects near an animal's enclosure."
As well as being famous online, Fiona's story inspired an ice cream flavour and a character in Cincinnati's ballet.
Cincinnati Mayor Aftab Pureval said Fiona "was a symbol of perseverance and joy" in the city.
"She brought smiles to so many faces, from kids to parents to visitors from around the world," he wrote on X. "Our city is heartbroken, but we couldn't be more grateful that she was part of our lives and our community as a whole."

Apple’s job listing describes an AI agent that can browse the web, work across apps, and call services.
Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That’s according to a job listing spotted by Bloomberg , which says Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI assistant.
An AI agent from Apple would put the iPhone maker in the running to compete with the likes of Meta’s Muse , OpenAI’s Dots , Anthropic’s Duet , and Google’s Tasks . Muse, ChatGPT, and Perplexity can already take control of a computer through their Mac apps, while Google just started letting Gemini do the same.
Apple began rolling out its AI-upgraded Siri in September, which you can use to ask questions about what’s on your screen, as well as perform actions across apps. It looks like Apple is planning to give Siri more agentic capabilities , as a report from Bloomberg suggests the company could add the ability to rotate and crop images in Photos, or organize Safari tabs. This lines up with the company’s new job listing, which says the engineer will work closely with teams across its Siri, UI Frameworks, and Apple Foundation Models divisions.
“People already do their most valuable work by moving fluidly between tools: a browser, a document, a terminal, an editor, a service,” the job listing says. “We’re building AI agents that can do the same… These agents plan and carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs, and they can coordinate specialized sub-agents along the way.”
With its upcoming iOS 27.3 update , Apple is also giving developers the ability to integrate Siri AI into “all apps.” This is rolling out as part of a Developer Preview and will eventually allow Siri to perform tasks across a wider range of apps.

Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information . CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm “in time for the holidays in December,” but he didn’t provide a price at the time.

Meta plans to charge $300 for Muse Charm, its upcoming Tamagotchi-like AI device that was teased at the company’s Connect event earlier this year, The Information has reported .
When reached for comment by TechCrunch, a Meta spokesperson didn’t deny the claims, merely providing the following statement: “We’re charmed by the interest in our AI devices, and we’ll have more to share soon.”
So far, Meta has made a relatively successful push into consumer AI, launching Muse — its agentic helper — along with a variety of cute avatars that users can use to give the system more of a personality.
Muse Charm, the company’s push into AI hardware, will allow users to carry a physical personification of its software around in their pocket (or potentially wear it around their neck), talking to it, asking it questions, and giving it commands.
It remains to be seen whether customers will bite or not. AI wearables have had a rough go of it so far (here’s looking at you, Humane Ai pin ), but companies continue to iterate on the concept in an attempt to break through to a broader audience.
Indeed, $300 is arguably a pretty steep price for a product the size of a keychain, although it’s also a price point that’s in line with what other companies have been charging. The wearable launched by Friend — the AI startup whose device lets you text and talk to an AI persona — is currently retailing for $250. On the other hand, Amazon’s all-new Bee Frontier wearable AI device — which transcribes conversations and tracks tasks — lists for $75 and is currently on a Black Friday, 30% off sale of $52.49. Even with its $99/year subscription to let it tie into a user’s apps (photos, emails, etc.), it’s still far less expensive than Muse Charm.

Apple appears to be working on its own AI agent to conduct computer work on behalf of users — including using apps, accessing websites, and coding, among other things.
The news was originally reported by Bloomberg, which spotted a job listing the iPhone maker recently posted for a senior engineering manager to oversee the creation of an “AI agent that can use a computer.”
“Imagine an AI agent that can use a computer the way a capable person does,” the posting says. “It browses the web, works across apps, runs commands, writes and debugs code, and calls services, and it chooses the right tool for each step. It does all this privately and with the polish people expect from Apple.”
The posting additionally notes that the agents should be able to move “fluidly between tools” and “carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs.”
TechCrunch reached out to Apple for more information but did not receive a response.
Agents capable of computer work have become one of the hottest commodities in the tech industry over the past year. Major labs like Anthropic and OpenAI have launched such services, while other major tech brands — like Meta, which recently launched its Muse agent line — have also moved into the space. It makes sense that Apple — which is trying to expand its AI offerings in the new John Ternus era — would want to follow suit.
Bloomberg additionally notes that, at the same time that Apple is working on its own digital assistant, the company is making it significantly harder for third-party agents to gain total control over its computers.
The outlet notes that the version of its upcoming macOS 27.3 will deploy warnings discouraging users from granting full access to third-party agents. In October, Apple issued a notification to developers stating that the company planned to “introduce additional controls to ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action.”
Bloomberg writes that while the iPhone maker “has eyed introducing the service as soon as the end of next year,” progress on its in-house agent “remains in the early stages.”

Rockstar Games'in geliştirdiği Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6), 19 Kasım'daki çıkışıyla yalnızca oyun sektöründe değil, küresel internet altyapısında da etkisini gösterdi.
Önde gelen internet değişim noktası işletmecilerinden DE-CIX'in verilerine göre, oyunun indirilmesi sırasında ağ trafiği tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyesine ulaştı.
18 Kasım'da akşam saatlerinde kaydedilen veri trafiği, saniyede 33,03 terabite (Tbps) yükseldi.
Bu yoğunluk, oyunun farklı ülkelerde gece yarısından itibaren erişime açılmasından hemen önce milyonlarca kullanıcının indirme işlemlerini gerçekleştirdiği saatlerde yaşandı.
DE-CIX'e göre GTA 6'nın çıkış dönemindeki veri trafiği, 2026'nın başından itibaren kaydedilen normal bir haftaya kıyasla yaklaşık yüzde 25 daha yüksekti.
GTA 6, piyasaya sürülmeden önce de internet trafiğinde rekor kırmıştı.
Oyunun ön indirmeye açıldığı 10 Kasım'da DE-CIX'in küresel ağ trafiği saniyede 33,01 terabite ulaşmıştı.
Bu trafiğin 22,30 terabitlik bölümü, şirketin Frankfurt'taki internet değişim noktasında kaydedilmişti.
DE-CIX, Frankfurt'ta ulaşılan bu veri miktarının, yaklaşık 210 GB büyüklüğündeki GTA 6'nın her saniye 13 kez tamamen indirilmesine eşdeğer olduğunu belirtti.
İnternet trafiğindeki artış, GTA 6'nın ticari başarısına ilişkin beklentilerin de ne kadar yüksek olduğunu gösteriyor.
Bazı sektör raporlarına göre oyunun dağıtılan dijital kopya sayısı 17 milyonu aşarken, ön sipariş gelirlerine ilişkin tahminler 1,65 milyar dolar seviyesine ulaştı.
Serinin bir önceki oyunu GTA 5, 2013 yılında piyasaya sürüldükten sonraki üç gün içerisinde 1 milyar dolar gelir elde etmişti.
Oyunun çıkışıyla birlikte canlı yayın platformlarında da yoğunluk yaşandı. İlk verilere göre GTA 6 yayınları aynı anda 6,38 milyon izleyiciye ulaşarak yeni bir rekor kırdı.
Oyun, inceleme platformu Metacritic'te 100 üzerinden 99 puana ulaşarak platform tarihinde kaydedilen en yüksek puanı da paylaştı.
GTA 6'nın yarattığı veri trafiğini dikkat çekici kılan bir başka unsur ise oyunun çıkış sırasında henüz çevrimiçi çok oyunculu modunun bulunmaması.
Yalnızca tek oyunculu deneyim sunan oyun, buna rağmen milyonlarca kişinin aynı anda indirme işlemi yapması nedeniyle internet altyapısında tarihi bir yoğunluğa yol açtı.
GTA Online'ın yeni sürümünün kullanıma sunulmasıyla birlikte veri trafiğinde yeni zirvelerin görülmesi bekleniyor.
Öte yandan, uzmanların açıkladığı rakamlar, internetin tamamının yavaşladığı veya çöktüğü anlamına gelmiyor. Veriler, DE-CIX'in işlettiği internet değişim noktalarından geçen toplam trafiğin rekor seviyeye ulaştığını gösteriyor.

Fiona, the Cincinnati Zoo’s famous hippo who charmed observers around the world, tragically died on Thursday due to medical complications after ingesting a knit hat that mistakenly entered her enclosure last week, according to zoo officials. Fiona was just nine years old when she died.
According to zoo officials, the hat that caused her death entered her enclosure after a child tossed it into the air. The hat reportedly collided with a ceiling fan, which then launched the hat through a “one-foot gap above the 12-foot-tall viewing window." A few days after eating the hat, her condition began to deteriorate.
For nonexperts, Fiona’s tragic death raises several questions: Why and how would a knit hat kill a hippo that weighs more than 2,500 pounds? Why wasn’t surgery possible for Fiona? And for zookeepers, what was the range of treatment scenarios available?
Jan Hawkins, the head of the the clinical science department at North Carolina State University's College of Veterinary Medicine, tells WIRED that—with the caveat that we won’t officially know until doctors conduct a post-mortem analysis—Fiona’s death was likely due to one of a few downstream effects of the hat getting caught somewhere in her intestinal tract.
In a sense, an intestinal blockage in a hippo is like a car crash on an incredibly long one-lane highway. Hawkins said that, estimating, a hippo’s intestinal tract is likely over 100 feet long, with more than 70 feet in the small intestines alone. In humans, the lengths of the small and large intestines are a comparably diminutive 25 feet.
Hawkins says that in a healthy hippo, liquids can take as little as 12 hours to pass, and food takes two to three days. According to zoo officials, Fiona ate the hat on or about Sunday, November 8. Zoo officials claimed that Fiona was asymptomatic at first, but began to lose her appetite after a few days. If the hat was going to come out, Hawkins says it likely would have happened within five days. So what happened?
One possibility, Hawkins says, is that when the hat got stuck, it caused a huge amount of swelling and pressure in her abdomen. That swelling could have led to her blood circulation being cut off, and eventually, to tissue death. After becoming green or black, Hawkins says that dead tissue is more likely to leak, and perhaps rupture, releasing the contents of the digestive tract into her blood. This can easily cause toxic shock.
In Fiona’s situation, this would mean that bacteria in her digestive tract died and released toxic molecules. Hawkins says that if these toxins enter the bloodstream, it would cause the organs to become more and more inflamed. Ultimately, this can lead to organ failure and death.
Another possibility is that, after the hat got stuck, Fiona’s intestines began to “twist on itself,” Hawkins says. This would be more likely if the hat, say, got pieces of food stuck inside of it, gradually becoming larger and heavier. Intestines are supposed to contract and move as they digest food. This means that if a heavy object gets stuck, the intestine can start to twist around it. In severe cases, this can cut off blood circulation. Eventually, this too can lead to tissue death. This initiates the chain of intestines leaking or rupturing, toxins entering the bloodstream, and organs becoming inflamed and eventually failing.
We don’t know exactly where the hat was in Fiona’s digestive tract. However, in a video the Cincinnati Zoo published to X on Tuesday, an unnamed staffer claimed that an ultrasound showed “some bunching of intestines.” They believed this meant that Fiona was “passing some things through her small intestine.”
If the hat was in Fiona’s small intestine, this would have meant that it passed through all three of her stomachs. (Hippos have three stomachs.) This could provide some hints about the type of hat that Fiona ate.
Hawkins says that in hippos, all three of their stomachs have the same basic components, but in different amounts. The first stomach has the largest amount of bacteria and protozoa, which help break down big pieces of food in the earliest part of digestion. The third has the highest amounts of enzymes and hydrochloric acid, which reduce food scraps into their smallest-possible size before entering the small intestine.
“Let's say it was a cotton hat or some sort of organic material, it's possible that that could partially break down,” Hawkins tells WIRED. “Whereas if it had something that would not degrade—so a plastic, or polyester, or something like that—then obviously its character is not gonna break down at all.”
The effects of this, Hawkins says, would be even more severe if the hat was rigid, or not collapsible in any way. “If it wouldn't get scrunched down, like a hair scrunchie, then you could understand why it would get stuck,” Hawkins says. “Because it can't change its character as much.”
All of this, Hawkins says, may have affected whether Fiona was able to pass the hat.
According to the Cincinnati Zoo’s Tuesday video , conducting surgery to remove the hat would not be possible for Fiona. The zoo claimed that a combination of specialists—including “veterinarian human specialists,” zoo employees, and “other experts”—came to the conclusion that surgery wasn’t the best option, and that the “best chance for success with Fiona would be if she can pass this on her own.”
Rebecca Lewison—San Diego State University biology professor, and co-chair of the Hippo Specialist Group of the International Union for Conservation of Nature—tells WIRED that when it comes to hippo surgery, a major challenge is their “unpredictable and irregular responses to sedation and anesthesia.”
“It is very risky for [hippos], and they can die from the standard medication used on other large animals, like elephants and rhinos, for reasons we don't well understand,” Lewison tells WIRED.
There are also some inherent challenges to administering anaesthesia on an animal as large as Fiona. When a human or animal goes under anesthesia, they need to be put on a ventilator that artificially breathes for them. An animal that weighs more than 2,500 pounds, Hawkins says, requires a ventilator of a much different scale than what humans need for general surgery.
Fiona was placed under anaesthesia to conduct bloodwork, according to the Cincinnati Zoo’s Tuesday video . But Hawkins says that the amount of anesthesia required for bloodwork is much smaller than what would be required for a major surgery, like removing a foreign object from her intestines. For Fiona, the increased amount of anaesthesia alone increases the risk of the surgery.
Another fact to consider, Hawkins says, is the position the zoo would feasibly be able to place her in while conducting surgery. If a human is in surgery, they may be placed on their back, their stomach, on their side, or in a variety of other positions. With animals like hippos, Hawkins says, this gets more complicated.
“You would have to have a hoist, a forklift or something, to pick them up to put them on either a pad or on a table,” Hawkins says. And if a zoo doesn’t have a table that’s big enough, the animal may have to go on the floor.
But Hawkins says that even at perfectly resourced zoos, there are other risks for hippos. In order to perform a major surgery, an animal as large as Fiona would have to have a huge amount of anaesthesia, putting her unconscious, and in the same position, for a long period of time. She would have her entire body weight putting pressure on the parts of her body that can’t move. This would limit her body’s ability to circulate oxygen—even with the help of a great ventilator.
If an animal is unhealthy, Hawkins says, the risks are even greater. In its Tuesday video , the Cincinnati Zoo said that when it recently ran some tests on Fiona, it found that she was dehydrated. This means that her body was already working extra hard to circulate blood not only to the blockage, but through the rest of her body.

Geliştiricileri Grand Theft Auto (GTA) oyununun çıkış hikayesini anlattı.
Dünyada gündem 13 yıllık bekleyiş, ertelemeler ve sızıntıların ardından 19 Kasım’da oyuncuyla buluşan Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6. Peki popüler oyun nasıl ortaya çıktı?
Orijinal GTA’yı 1997’de İskoçya’nın Dundee kentinde serinin sonraki oyunlarına göre nispeten küçük bir ekip, DMA Design piyasaya sürdü. Bulmaca oyunu Lemmings’le başarı yakalayan stüdyo, başta Race’n’Chase adlı bir yarış oyunu yapma fikriyle yola çıktı.
Serinin ortak geliştiricilerinden Dave Jones’a göre geliştiriciler hala yeni bir iş ortaya koymaları gerektiğini düşünüyor: “DMA’da her zaman farklı bir şey yapmak istedik. Buna katabileceğimiz benzersiz özellik neydi? Arabadan inmek.”
Ona göre sadece araba sürmekle kalmayıp değiştirebilme ve çalabilme, bunu yaparken de yaya olarak hareket edebilme fikri, birdenbire ilginç bir karışımı, yani GTA’yı ortaya çıkardı.
Jones’un söylediğine göre ekip hem suçlu hem polis olarak oynayabileceğiniz bir oyun tasarlamıştı. Ancak ikinci seçenek sonra yeniden değerlendirildi; çünkü bu, oyuncuların ‘kurallara uygun’ davranmasını gerektirecekti:
“Bir noktada ‘Kötü adamı oynamak çok daha eğlenceli’ dedik, bu yüzden oyunun konusu da bu oldu. Biz sadece eğlenceli olduğunu düşündüğümüz şeyleri yaptık. Hiçbir zaman ‘Bunu yapmalı mıyız? Tartışmalı mı olur?’ diye düşünmedik. Hiç böyle düşünmedik.”
The Guardian’ın video oyunları editörü Keza MacDonald’a göre oyun Amerikan şehirlerinde geçse de İskoç kökleri, mizahında hissediliyor:
“Bu son derece hiciv dolu bir oyun. ABD’nin aşırı bireyci ve aşırı kapitalist yapısını doğrudan hedef alıyor.”
Ekip, kısmen görece düşük bütçeleri ve gerçek markaların lisanslarını kullanmanın maliyeti nedeniyle oyuncuların etrafta dolaşıp ortalığı birbirine katarken dinleyebileceği hayali radyo istasyonları ve esprili sahte marka isimleri kullandı.
Bu tercihin bazıları zorunluluktan kaynaklansa da BBC’ye göre ilk oyunun senaristi ve tanıtımından sorumlu Brian Baglow şöyle dedi:
“İlk oyunda en gurur duyduğum unsur dünya inşası. Bu, bugün de bir oyuna ‘GTA hissi’ veren temel özelliklerden biri. İşletme isimleri, radyo istasyonları, şarkı sözleri, DJ’ler… Bunların her biri, içinde bulunduğunuz dünyanın büyük ve bütünlüklü bir evren olduğuna sizi inandırmaya hizmet ediyor.”

In the 90s, it aligned with utility boots and grunge fashion, but it quickly grew to focus on casual, comfortable, and athletic shoes for basically everyone. Today, you’ll see some of Skechers' most prominent shoe lines, including “Cozy Fit”, “Slip-ins”, and “Wide Fit”.
Like most brands, it also offers a few Skechers coupons, promo codes, and online offers that can help you save a few bucks at checkout. Below are some of the best Skechers coupons and promo codes you should know about before checking out.

From sampling to streaming, the rock legend has always been in thrall to technology – but is superintelligence a step too far? Back with an epic new album, he unpacks his remarkable ideas
P eter Gabriel asks me to fetch my laptop: he wants to show me a video of himself playing a keyboard duet with a bonobo called Kanzi. In fairness, said footage is, as Gabriel suggests, “extraordinary”. Working with primatologist Sue Savage-Rumbaugh, who developed a means of communicating with bonobos involving sign language and a speech-synthesis keyboard, Gabriel plays droning chords on a synthesiser while Kanzi picks out complementary notes on a piano. “Look, she likes that note, which is a ninth, and then she finds the octave,” he enthuses as the video plays. “There’s a real musicality there.”
It is all deeply unlikely, but it seems the perfect illustration of how easily a conversation with Gabriel can go wildly – if fascinatingly – off-piste. I’ve only been in his company for 10 minutes, long enough to ask a solitary question about his epic new album o\i: its 13 tracks last nearly 90 minutes, the result, he suggests, of a longstanding interest in African music “which made me realise that a song could last as long as a song could last”, and of “being old enough to think ‘fuck it’, really”. For anyone who feels that an hour and a half of exquisitely arranged, beautifully produced, occasionally deeply strange art rock – its sound shapeshifting from the folk-flecked A Hard Lesson to the glowing pop hues of Till Your Mind Is Shining – is too meagre an offering, it arrives in two versions: a “dark” mix by US producer Tchad Blake and a “bright” version that’s the handiwork of Mike “Spike” Stent, famed for working with everyone from U2 and Madonna to Frank Ocean and Harry Styles.
I had mentioned the two versions, a routine enough inquiry, but it quickly turns into a discussion about the potential replacement of car stereos with immersive sound systems, which then unexpectedly shifts into an explanation of the work of Michael Levin, an American professor of bioengineering who specialises in morphogenesis. “He’s found some bio-electric instructions that can make an eye grow on the leg of a frog, for example,” says Gabriel, and has apparently “created life forms that never existed before, which really challenges evolution.” Gabriel is interested in “sonifying” some of his data and using it in a subsequent mix of the album.
From there, we move on to software engineer Blaise Agüera y Arcas, whose experiments with an esoteric 90s programming language called Brainfuck have led him to “the radical idea that some constants in maths might actually have some form of life”. This leads us, via the “re-evaluation of what consciousness is and what intelligence is”, to the belief of internet pioneer Vint Cerf that attempting to communicate with other intelligent species might prepare us for the possibility of encountering aliens, and thus to Savage-Rumbaugh and Kanzi the bonobo.
“She used to allow the bonobos to watch videos, and to choose the videos they watched,” Gabriel says, laughing, “and their favourite, perhaps obviously, was Planet of the Apes, then Harry and the Hendersons, which is a film about a sasquatch who came to live with a family. The whole thing blew me away. I think we’re the most arrogant of all apes, and there’s just so much intelligence we’ve chosen to ignore and instead see the world as something that’s entirely available for our exploitation, and I think that’s cost us, as we are now learning.”
M orphogenisis, inter-species communication, the re-evaluation of consciousness: it should go without saying that you don’t usually end up discussing these things when you ask an august rock legend about his latest album. But, as it turns out, that’s what inevitably happens when you ask Gabriel a question. We meet in a pub not far from his home in Notting Hill. He says he’s here “to sell the new album”, but almost every query about it seems to lead him somewhere completely different: science, activism, the nature of consciousness, how language is “a fairly crude tool” for communication, the controversial 1970s self-improvement courses of Werner Erhard.
You can’t fault his diversity of interests, even if that diversity of interests is why it takes so long for him to make albums. o\i is essentially the second part of a project that began with 2023’s i/o, which was his first album of new material in 21 years. Like its predecessor, it contains songs that Gabriel has spent decades tinkering with: he started work on A Hard Lesson in 1989, when he was still a huge mainstream pop star thanks to 1986’s So, an album that shifted more than 5m copies in the US alone.
Yes, he concedes, it is a bit weird to find yourself, at the age of 76, still working on songs you started writing in your 30s: “I recognise that guy, but you’re bound to make different decisions having lived a little longer.” But that’s just the way it is. His friend Laurie Anderson once suggested that Gabriel’s problem was that he was more interested in the process of making something than in finishing it. He thinks the real issue is that he’s easily distracted.
“If you have some measure of success, you end up meeting all sorts of people and having fascinating conversations, which lead to detours, and you think, ‘Well, life is for living,’” he says. “If you get on that conveyor belt of album-tour-album, there’s not time to breathe or have any kind of life, and that always seems somewhat sad to me. I think the diversions feed the music. You know, if you want a better class of shit, you’ve got to eat a more varied diet.”
Hence the digressive nature of our interview. Gabriel seems to have developed a genuinely intriguing theory about virtually everything, from theme parks to funerals: he thinks people should “plant a tree over their dead body, or the dead body of their loved ones, so you’d get woods where there wouldn’t be any signage, but if you go and sit under your dad’s tree, your phone would have the GPS position and you would start seeing his videos, hearing his voice, all the digital data would be locked into that GPS point”.
Moreover, he has an incredibly engaging way of talking about all this stuff, evincing such enthusiasm and curiosity that you’re carried along with him: on the off-chance that you wanted to pitch the idea of growing eyeballs on the legs of frogs, you could do substantially worse than get Gabriel to act as your salesman. It probably helps his cause that Gabriel has a hugely impressive track record of thinking ahead of the curve.
At the height of his fame as the frontman of Genesis, he was sharp enough to realise that the genre of progressive rock they had helped invent was becoming too grandiloquent and remote for its own good – “prancing around in fairyland” as he once put it – and that the band he had formed might be more successful without him. The latter opinion wasn’t very popular with the rest of Genesis, but nevertheless proved to be spot on.
A few years later, he was the first British artist to realise that the future of pop lay in sampling: for some time in the early 80s, if you wanted to use a sampler on your new track you had to borrow Gabriel’s, because he was the first person in the country to own one; he then set up a company to import and distribute the new technology. Twenty years later, he cottoned on very quickly to the idea that music was going to primarily exist online, co-founding a streaming platform that might have become the industry standard had it not launched at exactly the same time as a competitor called Spotify.
I f he was right about everything from sampling to streaming to the latter-day career of Genesis, perhaps he’s also right about AI. In a musical world filled with people decrying its malign influence, Gabriel is one of its few high-profile boosters: he recently suggested that ultimately “everything will be done better” by AI than by humans.
He says it agai…

Since launching as a direct-to-consumer furniture brand in 2013, Castlery has built a reputation for design-forward products that look good and perform even better. Castlery’s aesthetic leans mid-century modern, favoring earthy tones, rounded edges, and natural wood finishes that outlast fleeting trends. But it’s the functionality that won WIRED over. Think: Hidden storage compartments, modular layouts, multi-functional pieces, and performance fabrics that can withstand everyday use. We also care about sustainability, and Castlery’s furniture is made to last. Many products are responsibly sourced and safe from heavy metals, allergenic dyes, and other harmful chemicals. You can read more about the brand’s sustainability practices here .
I adore my Castlery Auburn Storage Bed ; it gives my room a clean Scandinavian feel and hides my suitcases and whatever else I can fit underneath. I also have the Auburn Sectional , and I love it for similar reasons. It’s upholstered in the same PFAS-free polyester fabric as the bed frame . It does a brilliant job of camouflaging stains, makes cleaning spills easy, and is surprisingly resilient against my cats. It’s not completely claw-proof, but it outperforms every other couch I’ve had.
If you’re furnishing a room—perhaps you just moved or are due for a seasonal refresh—Castlery is a hard-to-beat recommendation. And with a bunch of Castlery discounts and Castlery promo codes available, it’s a little easier to justify the upgrade.
Be sure to check out the Castlery Black Friday Sale for all your home goods and furniture needs. During the sale, you can get $150 off $1,500, $280 off $2,500, $600 off $4,500, and $950 off $7,000 or more with Castlery promo code SAVEMORE . You can expect to see sales for up to 40% off sofas and armchairs, an extra $80 off select bed bundles, up to 45% off beds and mattresses, up to 45% off dining sets, up to 30% off storage, and up to 50% off outdoor items and other accessories.
Castlery’s collections are stunning and, sometimes, surprisingly durable. Fortunately, the brand makes it easy to bundle pieces for a discount when you’re furnishing an entire room, right now with up to 15% off furniture sets. You can mix and match across living room setups, outdoor furniture, dining sets, and bedroom bundles that include matching nightstands. I’m especially partial to the Auburn line , which has held up impressively well against my cats. Castlery also offers white-glove delivery, so you don’t have to do any of the heavy lifting.
If you shop at Castlery a lot, it’s time to get rewarded for the purchases you were already going to make. The Castlery Club is a rewards program that gives reward points for purchases, giving credits for savings and discounts on future purchases. When you refer a friend and they sign up for The Castlery Club, they’ll get $100 off their first purchase, and you’ll get rewarded with 100 credits to your account. It’s a win-win.
In select major cities, Castlery customers can qualify for free US shipping on orders of $999 or more—or $1,199, depending on your location. This offer applies automatically at checkout once the minimum spending amount is met. Keep in mind that shipping is charged per shipment, not per order. If your items ship separately, you may see multiple delivery fees tied to a single purchase. For full details, check Castlery’s delivery page .
First-time shoppers can score a Castlery discount by signing up for Castlery’s newsletter , which sends a unique promo code for $50 or $80 off your first order (depending on the promotional period). It’s also the best way to stay in the loop on new product drops and early access to sales.
Join the Castlery Club , the company’s free loyalty program, and earn credits on every dollar you spend. Those credits can be redeemed for future discounts and member-only perks throughout the year. There are also a few low-effort ways to rack up credits without even buying anything. For example, you’ll get 10 credits for signing up for emails, 10 for following Castlery on Instagram, 20 for updating your profile, 75 for leaving a product review, and 100 for referring a friend, which amount to a Castlery discount down the line.
Castlery understands that furniture is a major investment, so it offers flexible financing options to ease the upfront cost. Through Affirm, you can split your purchase into manageable monthly payments, with low or even 0% APR available depending on your credit and any current Castlery promo codes. The application is straightforward and happens at checkout.

If you’re hunting for a new vacuum, Dyson has likely come up in one way or another. The brand is famous for its powerful vacuum cleaners , but its air power also extends to other parts of the home, including hair care and air purification. It’s a dream household staple; I lugged around an old Dyson vacuum for years until I could upgrade to a newer stick model rather than buying something that wouldn’t be as powerful or last as long.
But the cost can make it a hard investment, even if it’s worth it. If you’re shopping for one of Dyson’s long-lasting gadgets but have a limited budget, fear not: we’ve got coupon codes to make it a better buy, plus tips on how to get discounts on Dyson’s website. Read on to get all of our Dyson promo codes and coupons, and learn the best ways to shop for a Dyson.
Dyson is one of the best and most enduring brands of our time. Dyson doesn’t run tons of sales often, so if you’re looking to buy a Dyson product, we have the best ways to save right here. First, be sure to sign up for Dyson’s newsletter to get early access to Dyson’s Black Friday offers and deals. Not only will Dyson have lots of discounts and promotions during the holiday sale, but Dyson will also have deals during the early Dyson Black Friday period in the run-up to Black Friday, for even more opportunities to save. This means savings across all of Dyson’s top tech categories, including hair stylers, hair straighteners, hair dryers, air purifiers, and vacuum cleaners—be sure to keep checking back as more offers are added as the holidays approach.
Usually, you need to be a new customer to get a great discount, but Dyson rewards you for being a repeat customer. You can get 15% off your next order by registering your current Dyson product’s serial number .
You can also get 10 percent off your next Dyson purchase without needing a device to register. You’ll want to sign up your mobile number via a pop-up on Dyson’s homepage . That will send you a text, and you’ll have to reply with “Y” to officially register. After you reply, you’ll receive a message with a link that reveals a single-use code for 10 percent off your next purchase at Dyson.
You can also sign up for texts or Dyson’s email newsletters (like this hair care newsletter) to access exclusive Dyson sale events, more coupon codes, and new product releases (and several new vacuums are due out this year).
Dyson always has sales on its website at the Dyson Deals Hub . The discounts rotate weekly, and there are always different active coupons across different categories of Dyson products. You might find a nice discount on the V12 vacuum , for instance, or on the Dyson Airstrait .
Looking for a bigger discount? Try Dyson’s outlet for refurbished vacuums, hair tools, and air purifiers. You’ll find discounts of up to 30 percent off the original price, and each one is inspected, restored to like-new condition, and backed by Dyson’s official warranty. It’s a good way to get great deals on products like the Supersonic hair dryers, which you can find for under $200 when refurbished, and Dyson’s multi-stylers can be found for under $300. These do have a shorter warranty period than new products, though; it’ll only be six months to a year rather than two to five years.
If you’re looking to invest in this often pricey, long-lasting technology, I’d suggest checking the Dyson deals page, where you can see all the exclusive rotating Dyson offers available right now and shop by category, like cordless vacuums, hair care, air treatment, headphones, and more. Some of the best deals I’ve seen so far include the viral Dyson Airwrap Origin multi-styler and dryer , which has three attachments and is $150 off right now, and the V12 Detect Slim, a highly-rated cordless Dyson vacuum with 60 minutes of run time for $250 off.
Like all of Dyson’s tech lineup, Dyson hair tools have the signature high power, efficiency, sleek design, … and high price tag. One of Dyson’s most iconic and enduring tools is the Dyson Airwrap, which debuted in 2018. We rated it a 9/10 WIRED Recommends for its multifunctionality, offerings for different hair types, less heat use than previous models, and a light, easy-to-use design.
When it comes to hair gadgets, there are many gimmicks that claim to make styling easy and effortless, but the Dyson Airwrap actually works, using air to draw strands of your hair around the curling barrels to produce a lasting result without subjecting your hair to excessive damaging heat. It's a multifunction styler, but the Airwrap really shines as a curling iron. Powered by its internal motor, it creates a vortex of air inside the hollow barrel, powerful enough to draw your hair to it. All you have to do is place the end of your hair near the barrel, and the machine does the gripping and wrapping for you, so you don't have to worry about touching a hot curling barrel.
I’m of the opinion that everyone needs an air purifier and a fan . So why not combine both? (Especially if you are short on space, like me.) We at WIRED love the Dyson Purifier Cool PC2, which works in tandem to cool the air with purified air. Not only does it function as a fan, blowing cool air, but it also captures gases and 99% of pollutants, redistributing cool, purified air throughout your home for a healthier living space. It also conveniently connects to the MyDyson app for hands-free control anywhere, and it’s $200 off right now.
If you’re looking to invest in this often pricey, long-lasting technology, I’d suggest checking out the Dyson deals page, where you can see all the exclusive rotating Dyson offers available right now and shop by category, such as cordless vacuums, hair care, air treatment, headphones, and more.

Çocukların eğitimden korunmaya kadar birçok hakkı var. Ancak veriler yoksulluk, çocuk işçiliği ve önlenebilir ölümlerin sürdüğünü gösteriyor. Türkiye'de de her 100 çocuktan yüzde 37'si risk altında.
Bir çocuk okula gitmenin, oyun oynamanın ve kötü muameleden korunmanın birer hak olduğunu biliyor mu?
Haklarını bilmek, başına geleni anlatmasını ve yardım istemesini kolaylaştırabilir. Onu dinlemek ve korumak ise yetişkinlerin ve kurumların sorumluluğu. Her yıl 20 Kasım'da çocuk hakları üzerine yazılar yazılıyor, açıklamalar yapılıyor. Peki bir 20 Kasım'dan ötekine çocukların hayatında ne değişiyor?
Birleşmiş Milletler (BM) Genel Kurulu, 20 Kasım 1959'da kabul ettiği Çocuk Hakları Bildirgesi'nde her çocuğun eğitim, oyun, yeterli beslenme ve barınma hakkı olduğunu ilan etti. Bildirge, çocukların ihmalden, kötü muameleden ve sömürüden korunmasını da öngörüyor.
Peki bugün Türkiye'de çocuklar yeterli beslenebiliyor mu? Okula devam edebiliyor mu? Sağlıklarına ya da eğitimlerine zarar verecek işlerden korunabiliyor mu?
BM Genel Kurulunun 20 Kasım 1959'da kabul ettiği Çocuk Haklarına Dair Sözleşme, ön sözünde 1959 Bildirgesi'ne atıf yapıyor. Bildirge'deki ilkeleri ayrıntılandıran sözleşme, taraf devletlere çocuk haklarını güvence altına almak için bağlayıcı yükümlülükler getirdi. Sözleşmenin 42'nci maddesi, devletlere sözleşmenin ilkelerini ve hükümlerini hem çocuklara hem yetişkinlere uygun ve etkili yollarla duyurma görevi de veriyor.
Sözleşmenin 12'nci maddesi, çocuğa kendisini ilgilendiren konularda görüşünü ifade etme hakkı tanıyor. Örneğin bir çocuğun kimle yaşayacağına ilişkin bir dava görülürken çocuğa görüşünü anlatma fırsatı verilmeli. Görüşüne yaşı ve olgunluğu ölçüsünde ağırlık verilmeli. Böylece çocuk, kendisiyle ilgili bir karar alınırken ne düşündüğünü ve neye ihtiyaç duyduğunu anlatabiliyor.
Sözleşmenin 27'nci maddesi, her çocuğun gelişimine elverişli bir yaşam düzeyine hakkı olduğunu belirtiyor. Devletlerin gerektiğinde ailelere özellikle beslenme, giyim ve barınma alanlarında destek sağlamasını öngörüyor.
Türkiye İstatistik Kurumunun (TÜİK) 2025 araştırmasına göre Türkiye'de her 100 çocuktan yaklaşık 37'si yoksulluk veya sosyal dışlanma riski altında. Genel nüfusta bu sayı yaklaşık her 100 kişide 28. Çocuklarda risk oranı bir önceki araştırmaya göre yüzde 38,9'dan yüzde 36,8'e gerilese de genel nüfusun yaklaşık 9 puan üzerinde. Gösterge, gelir yoksulluğunun yanı sıra maddi ve sosyal yoksunluğu ve hanedeki düşük çalışma yoğunluğunu da hesaba katıyor.
BM Çocuk Haklarına Dair Sözleşme'nin 28'inci maddesi, devlete okula düzenli devamı teşvik etme ve okuldan ayrılmaları azaltma görevi veriyor.
Milli Eğitim Bakanlığına göre 2025-2026 eğitim öğretim yılında net okullaşma oranı 6-9 yaşta yüzde 98,46, 10-13 yaşta yüzde 98,16 oldu. 14-17 yaş grubunda ise oran bir önceki eğitim yılına göre 0,67 puan artarak yüzde 87,09'a çıktı.
Okula kaydın ardından bir başka soru geliyor. Öğrenciler derslere ne kadar düzenli devam ediyor? MEB'in 2025 yıl sonu raporuna göre 20 gün veya daha fazla devamsızlık yapanların oranı genel ortaöğretimde yüzde 27,74, mesleki ve teknik ortaöğretimde yüzde 49,78 oldu. Mesleki ve teknik ortaöğretimde yaklaşık her iki öğrenciden biri en az 20 gün okula gitmedi.
TÜİK'in Hanehalkı İşgücü Araştırmasına göre 15-17 yaş grubunda ne eğitimde ne de istihdamda olan çocukların oranı 2024'te yüzde 10,8'den 2025'te yüzde 11,5'e yükseldi.
Çocuk Hakları Bildirgesi, çocukların sağlıklarına, eğitimlerine veya gelişimlerine zarar verebilecek işlerden korunmasını öngörüyor. BM Çocuk Haklarına Dair Sözleşme'nin 32'nci maddesi de devletlere asgari çalışma yaşını belirleme, çalışma saatlerini ve koşullarını düzenleme görevi veriyor.
TÜİK'e göre 2025'te 15-17 yaş grubunda 882 bin çocuk çalışıyordu. Bu yaş grubunda çalışanların oranı 2024'te yüzde 22,3 iken 2025'te yüzde 22,8'e çıktı. TÜİK'in ayrı bir çocuk iş gücü araştırmasına göre 2019'un son üç ayında 5-14 yaş grubunda çalışan 146 bin çocuğun yaklaşık üçte ikisi tarımdaydı.
İşçi Sağlığı ve İş Güvenliği (İSİG) Meclisinin kayıtlarına göre 2024-2025 eğitim yılında en az 72, 2025-2026 eğitim yılında ise en az 95 çocuk çalışırken hayatını kaybetti. 2025-2026 eğitim yılında kayda geçen ölümlerin 37'si tarımda, 27'si sanayide, 18'i inşaatta ve 13'ü hizmet sektöründeydi.
İSİG Meclisi, Eylül 2026'da sekiz, ekimde dokuz çocuğun çalışırken hayatını kaybettiğini bildirdi. İki ayda hayatını kaybeden 17 çocuğun dokuzu 14 yaşında veya daha küçüktü. Ölümlerin yedisi tarımda, dördü inşaatta gerçekleşti.
Sözleşmenin 19'uncu maddesine göre devlet, çocuğu şiddet, ihmal ve istismardan korumak için önlem almakla yükümlü. Bu önlemler,
istismarın tespit edilmesini, bildirilmesini ve soruşturulmasını, çocuğa ihtiyaç duyduğu desteğin sağlanmasını da kapsıyor.
Adalet Bakanlığı verilerine göre 2025'te çocukların cinsel istismarı suçundan başsavcılıklara 33 bin 407 yeni dosya geldi. Ceza mahkemeleri aynı yıl bu suçtan 15 bin 84 dosyayı karara bağladı. Çocuğun yardım isteyebileceği bir yere erişmesi ve süreç boyunca korunması da sözleşmenin devlete yüklediği sorumluluklar arasında.
Sözleşmenin 6'ncı maddesi, her çocuğun yaşama hakkını tanıyor. Devletlere çocukların hayatta kalmasını ve gelişmesini mümkün olan en geniş ölçüde güvence altına alma görevi veriyor.
Fikir ve Sanat Atölyesi Derneği (FİSA) Çocuk Hakları Merkezi'nin yayımladığı iki bilgi notuna göre 2026'nın ilk sekiz ayında Türkiye'de en az 542 çocuk önlenebilir nedenlerle hayatını kaybetti.
Merkezin kayıtlarına göre 133 çocuk trafik kazalarında, 57 çocuk da çalışırken yaşamını yitirdi. Aynı dönemde 31 çocuk intihar sonucu, 18 çocuk akran şiddeti nedeniyle, 12 çocuk ise bireysel silahlanmayla bağlantılı olaylarda hayatını kaybetti. Merkez, en az 60 çocuğun ölümünü de kamu kurumlarında yaşanan olaylar veya kamu görevlilerinin eylem ve ihmalleri kapsamında değerlendirdi.
27 Ocak 1995'te Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanan sözleşme, Türkiye açısından 4 Mayıs 1995'te yürürlüğe girdi. Türkiye, sözleşmedeki hakları ayrım gözetmeden güvence altına almayı ve çocukları ilgilendiren kararlarda çocuğun üstün yararını öncelikli olarak gözetmeyi üstlendi. Anayasa'nın 90'ıncı maddesi uyarınca, usulüne uygun biçimde yürürlüğe konulmuş temel hak ve özgürlüklere ilişkin uluslararası sözleşmelerle kanunlar aynı konuda farklı hükümler içerdiğinde sözleşme hükümleri esas alınıyor.
Türkiye, sözleşmenin bilgiye erişimle ilgili 17'nci maddesine, eğitimin amaçlarını düzenleyen 29'uncu maddesine ve azınlıklara mensup çocukların kültürlerini yaşama, dinlerini uygulama ve dillerini kullanma haklarını düzenleyen 30'uncu maddesine çekince koydu. Bu hükümleri Anayasa ve Lozan Antlaşması'na uygun biçimde yorumlama ve uygulama hakkını saklı tuttu. BM Çocuk Hakları Komitesi, 2023'teki Türkiye değerlendirmesinde çekincelerin geri çekilmesinin değerlendirilmesi çağrısını yineledi.

For professional photographers and photography enthusiasts, Adorama has long been the go-to for new and used cameras, lenses, accessories, and services such as repairs, rentals, and photo printing. The retailer has since expanded into home electronics, audio, and musical instruments—even dropping “camera” from its name, though that remains the heart and soul of the company. With roots dating to the 1970s, this New York City institution is among the most recognized retailers for the latest photographic equipment, backed by knowledgeable staff. We often link to Adorama in our camera buying guides and reviews because it is a trusted retailer.
If you’re shopping for a new camera or tripod, stocking up on Kodak film, or need a custom photo book made for gifting, check out these Adorama discounts before you check out. Adorama doesn’t require an Adorama Camera promo code or Adorama Camera coupon; instead, it prefers to drop prices from the get-go. Photography can be expensive, especially now that nearly all electronics have increased in price, so these Adorama promos and deals can help lessen the sting.
The best place to find what’s on sale at Adorama is its Deals and Specials section . Discounts are automatically applied, so there’s no code to enter. Save on cameras and lenses from Sony, Nikon, Canon, and Panasonic; accessories like speedlights, memory cards, and cases; computers, including MacBooks; home entertainment from the likes of Bose, Klipsch, and Onkyo; and much more. As with any sale, do some price comparison before you buy to make sure you can’t get it cheaper elsewhere.
Nearly every retailer has a loyalty program, and Adorama’s is VIP Rewards. It’s free to join, and you earn points every time you shop, which you can redeem as a cash discount on future purchases. VIP Rewards is straightforward: 500 points knock $5 off, while 20,000 points save $200. You can earn points in many ways beyond shopping, including referrals, product reviews, and special promotions. If you’re a frequent shopper, you should get rewarded. Did we mention it’s free?
Closeout items can be great deals if you don’t mind a discontinued item. Many are still supported and under warranty, but they may not be the latest and greatest or a big seller. Whatever the reason, Adorama’s clearance section is worth browsing. We spotted high-end hybrid tablet computers from Lenovo, Casio digital pianos, pro-grade flash media from SanDisk, Dell Thunderbolt displays, Polaroid instant film, and more. As with any sale item, make sure you can’t find it cheaper elsewhere and that it can be returned for a refund if you change your mind later.
Teachers and students can save up to 20 percent on new camera gear and up to 10 percent on used equipment when they sign up for Adorama’s Classroom Connect Program . It’s free to join, but you will need to verify that you are an educator or a student, regardless of discipline. Discounts range from 5 to 20 percent, depending on the product. Not all products qualify, but participating brands include Sony, Panasonic, BenQ, Fujifilm, and more. Even better, you can stack the education discount on top of a sale item (Black Friday is around the corner). To register, simply sign up on the Classroom Connect Program page.
Maybe someone special in your life is about to celebrate a milestone or achievement. Before you automatically get a gift card from that online retailer in Seattle, consider an Adorama card instead , especially if the giftee is into photography, video editing, or other creative pursuits. Choose either a digital or physical card from $25 to $1,000. It’s a great way for your giftee to save on top of sale items, and it does not expire.
Be sure to check back often for more Adorama Camera promo codes and Adorama Camera coupons.

Codex destekli sistem, performans düşüşlerinin nedenlerini araştırmaktan çözüm üretmeye ve yapılan değişikliklerin sonuçlarını kontrol etmeye kadar birçok süreci otomatik hale getiriyor.
OpenAI'ın paylaştığı verilere göre Performance Factory'nin ilk uygulaması olan Regression Workflow , üç aydan biraz uzun bir sürede 1.700'den fazla incelemeyi takip etti ve 600'den fazla performans sorununun temel nedenini belirledi. Bu da günde ortalama 17 otomatik incelemeye karşılık geliyor.
Şirketin bu sistemi geliştirmesinin arkasında, yapay zeka destekli yazılım geliştirme süreçlerinin giderek hızlanması bulunuyor. OpenAI mühendisleri daha önce performans sorunlarını tespit etmek için sistem ölçümlerini, günlük kayıtlarını ve kod değişikliklerini manuel olarak inceliyordu. Zamanla bu çalışmalar için 30'dan fazla araç geliştirildi. Ancak yazılım geliştirme hızlandıkça performans sorunlarını incelemek de daha fazla zaman almaya başladı.
OpenAI, bu süreci kolaylaştırmak amacıyla mühendislerin kullandığı inceleme yöntemlerini perf-forensics adlı bir Codex becerisine dönüştürdü. Böylece Codex, performans sorunlarının ne zaman başladığını, hangi işlemleri etkilediğini ve olası nedenlerini araştırabilir hale geldi.
Performance Factory, görevleri yöneten, işleri Codex ajanlarına dağıtan ve sonuçları takip eden dört temel bileşenden oluşuyor. Sistem, Codex'in OpenAI'ın bulut altyapısında çalışmasını sağlayarak kod depolarına, performans ölçümlerine, günlük kayıtlarına ve işlem izlerine erişmesine olanak tanıyor.
Süreç bir performans uyarısıyla başlıyor. Codex ajanı önce sorunun ne zaman ortaya çıktığını ve hangi işlemleri etkilediğini belirliyor. Ardından ilgili kod değişikliklerini, sistem kayıtlarını ve ölçümleri inceleyerek sorunun kaynağını araştırıyor.
OpenAI, ilk denemelerde ajanların bazen karşılaştıkları ilk makul açıklamayı doğru kabul ettiğini fark etti. Bunun üzerine sisteme ikinci bir Codex ajanının ilk ajanın bulgularını sorguladığı bir kontrol aşaması eklendi. Bu ajan, elde edilen sonuçları doğrulamak yerine olası hataları ve alternatif açıklamaları araştırıyor.
Şirketin manuel olarak değerlendirdiği 100 temel neden önerisinin yüzde 70'i doğru bulunurken, kalan yüzde 30'un daha fazla incelemeye ihtiyaç duyduğu belirtildi. Sorunun kaynağı belirlendikten sonra Codex bir düzeltme hazırlayabiliyor. Ancak önerilen kod değişikliklerinin uygulanması için mühendis onayı gerekiyor. Değişiklik yayına alındıktan sonra sistem, performans sorununun çözülüp çözülmediğini yeniden kontrol ediyor.
VentureBeat'in OpenAI ekibinden aldığı bilgilere göre , temel nedeni belirlenen 600'den fazla incelemenin yaklaşık 400'ünde çözüm önerisi oluşturuldu. Yayına alınan yaklaşık 50 düzeltme Codex'in önerilerinden etkilenirken, yaklaşık 15 düzeltmenin kodu doğrudan Codex tarafından hazırlandı.
OpenAI, gelecek dönemde Performance Factory'yi daha bağımsız çalışabilecek şekilde geliştirmeyi hedefliyor. Şirket, ajanların mevcut uyarı sistemlerinin fark edemediği küçük performans düşüşlerini de kendiliğinden tespit etmesini ve düşük riskli bazı düzeltmelerin daha az insan müdahalesiyle uygulanmasını planlıyor. Performance Factory, yapay zeka ajanlarının yalnızca kod yazmakla sınırlı kalmayıp yazılımların bakım ve performans süreçlerinde de giderek daha fazla sorumluluk üstlendiğini gösteriyor.

The US' national cyber director Sean Cairncross has been fired from his role, a source close to the White House told the AFP news agency on Thursday, following a wave of tech outages across the country.
Kirsten Davies, the defence department's chief information officer, is set to take over from Cairncross on a temporary basis, the source said.
"Congratulations to the new National Cyber Director Kirsten Davies — look forward to working together to strengthen America’s cybersecurity," US Secretary of State Marco Rubio wrote in a post on social media.
At the Pentagon, Davies has acted as the "principal advisor" to Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth "on all matters relating to information management, information technology, cybersecurity, and information assurance," her bio says.
The move comes after outages have hit travel, communications and banking, as well as an internal system used by the National Security Agency in recent weeks.
The national cyber director is tasked with advising the president on cybersecurity policy and strategy, including information security and data protection as well as deterrence of "malicious" activity.
The director also coordinates cyber policy across the federal government. The office was first established in 2021.
In March, the Trump administration released a seven-page document detailing its cyber strategy.
It pledged to "act swiftly, deliberately, and proactively to disable cyber threats" by streamlining cyber regulations, modernising federal information systems, hardening critical infrastructure and maintaining an edge in AI.
