Pelin Akil, ikiz kızları Alin ve Lina'nın babaları Anıl Altan'la GTA 6 oynadığını öğrenince şaşkınlığını gizleyemedi. Eski eşine WhatsApp üzerinden tepki gösteren oyuncunun mesajına Anıl Altan'dan esprili bir yanıt geldi. Mesajlaşmalarını Instagram hesabından paylaşan Pelin Akil eski eşine “gelecek linçlere cevap verirsin” dedi.
Arka Sıradakiler, Suskunlar, Eşkıya Dünyaya Hükümdar Olmaz, Çember, Ben Bu Cihana Sığmazam ve son olarak Yalı Çapkını dizisinde rol alan Pelin Akil, özel hayatıyla gündemden düşmüyor. Akil son olarak eski eşiyle mesajlarını ifşa etmesiyle gündem oldu.
Anıl Altan'ın kızlarına GTA oyununu oynatmasına sinirlenen Akil, 'Alin ve Lina babalarıyla yine dolu dolu bir gün geçirmiş. Ben hala hangi deniz diye soruyorum' dedi.
Mesajlarda Pelin Akil'in 'Gelecek linçlere cevap verirsin. Ben uğraşamıyorum seninle' derken Anıl Altan'ın da 'Ama sınırını aşan birisi olursa da nasıl davranmaları gerektiğini öğreniyorlar. Hayata hazırlanıyorlar' karşılığını verdiği görüldü.
İkili arasındaki mesajları güldürürken Pelin Akil de 'Çok iyi. Yarın öğretmen 'Büyüyünce ne olacaksın?' diye sorarsa 'Pilotum zaten' derler' ifadelerini kullandı.

Kasım indirimlerinin en büyük günü Black Friday kapıda. Bu yıl Kara Cuma, 27 Kasım 2026 Cuma gününe denk geliyor. Türkiye'de pek çok site ve marka ise indirimleri tek güne sığdırmayıp haftaya, hatta ay sonuna yayıyor.
Black Friday kaç gün sürüyor, Efsane Cuma ile aynı şey mi, indirimin gerçek olup olmadığı nasıl anlaşılır? En çok merak edilenleri derledik.
Black Friday, ABD 'de kasımın dördüncü perşembesi kutlanan Şükran Günü'nün ertesi günü yapılıyor. 2026'da Şükran Günü 26 Kasım Perşembe'ye denk geldiği için bu sene Black Friday 27 Kasım 2026 Cuma gününe denk geliyor.
Türkiye'de Black Friday için tek bir resmi tarih yok; kampanya takvimini her site ve marka kendisi belirliyor. Genel eğilim, indirimlerin 27 Kasım'dan birkaç gün önce başlaması ve 30 Kasım'daki Cyber Monday'e kadar sürmesi yönünde. Bazı markalar indirimi mobil uygulamada mağazalardan bir akşam önce açabiliyor.
Kesin başlangıç ve bitiş tarihleri için alışveriş yapacağınız sitenin ya da markanın kendi duyurusunu takip etmek en sağlıklısı.
Evet, ikisi aynı indirim dönemini anlatıyor. Black Friday'in Türkçe karşılığı olan 'Kara Cuma' olumsuz bir çağrışım yaptığı için Türkiye'de bu dönem daha çok Efsane Cuma adıyla biliniyor. Farklı alışveriş platformları da aynı haftayı kendi kampanya adlarıyla duyuruyor.
Black Friday'i izleyen pazartesi gününe Cyber Monday, yani Siber Pazartesi deniyor. 2026'da 30 Kasım Pazartesi gününe denk geliyor. Adından da anlaşılacağı gibi daha çok online alışverişe ve teknoloji ürünlerine yönelik kampanyalarla biliniyor.
Kampanyaya göre değişiyor. Bazı markalar indirimi hem fiziksel mağazalarda hem internette uyguluyor, bazıları ise yalnızca web sitesine ya da uygulamaya özel fırsatlar sunuyor.
Ürün yelpazesi ve indirim oranı da kanaldan kanala farklılaşabildiği için kampanya koşullarını alışverişten önce kontrol etmekte fayda var.
Ticaret Bakanlığı'nın 2022'de Ticari Reklam ve Haksız Ticari Uygulamalar Yönetmeliği'nde yaptığı değişikliğe göre, indirimli satış reklamlarında indirimin duyurulduğu tarihten önceki 30 gün içinde uygulanan en düşük fiyat , indirimden önceki fiyat olarak gösterilmek zorunda.
Yani bir ürün son bir ayda 800 TL'ye satıldıysa, 'yüzde 50 indirim' 1.000 TL değil 800 TL üzerinden hesaplanmalı. Almak istediğiniz ürünlerin fiyatını birkaç hafta önceden takip etmek de 'önce zam , sonra indirim' tuzağına düşmemenin en kolay yolu.
En yaygın açıklama 1960'lara dayanıyor: Philadelphia polisi, Şükran Günü'nün ertesi günü alışveriş kalabalığının yol açtığı trafik karmaşasını bu adla anıyordu. Sonradan, perakendecilerin bu günde defterlerdeki 'kırmızıdan' ( zarar ) 'siyaha' (kâr) geçtiği yorumu yaygınlaştı.
Not: Kampanya tarihleri ve koşulları markadan markaya değişebilir; alışveriş öncesinde markanın resmi kanallarını kontrol edin.

2016 yılında evlenen Pelin Akil ile Anıl Altan, 2019'da ikiz kızları Alin ve Lina'yı kucaklarına almıştı.
Arka Sıradakiler, Suskunlar, Eşkıya Dünyaya Hükümdar Olmaz, Çember, Ben Bu Cihana Sığmazam ve son olarak Yalı Çapkını dizisinde rol alan Pelin Akil , sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımla gündem oldu.
40 yaşındaki Pelin Akil , son olarak eski eşi ve ikiz kızlarının babası Anıl Altan ile olan mesajlarını ifşa etti.
Pelin Akil ile Anıl Altan'ın mesajları takipçilerini güldürdü.
Anıl Altan'ın tüm dünyayı kasıp kavuran GTA 6 'yı kızlarına da oynatmasına sinirlenen Akil, eski eşiyle konuşmasını “Alin ve Lina babalarıyla yine dolu dolu bir gün geçirmiş. Ben hala hangi deniz diye soruyorum” diyerek paylaştı.
Mesajlarda “Çocuklara GTA oynatmana inanamıyorum” diyen Akil'e eski eşi Altan “Denize girip yüzüyoruz, flamingoları kovalıyoruz. Sınırını aşan biri olursa nasıl davranmaları gerektiğini öğreniyorlar, hayata hazırlanıyorlar” diye cevap verdiği görüldü.
Pelin Akil 'in devamında “Gelecek linçlere cevap verirsin. Ben uğraşamıyorum seninle” demesi ve ikili arasındaki diyalog takipçilerini güldürdü.
GTA 6, oyun dünyasının önde gelen mecralarından ve dünya basınından tam puan aldı.
Rockstar Games'in geliştirdiği açık dünya aksiyon-macera oyunu GTA 6 , 13 yıllık bekleyişin ardından oyuncularla buluştu. 2013'te piyasaya çıkan GTA 5'in devamı niteliğindeki GTA 6 tüm dünyayı kasıp kavurdu.
Oyun, başarısız bir banka soygununun ardından büyük bir komplonun ortasında kalan Lucia Caminos ve Jason Duval adlı suç ikilisinin hayatta kalma mücadelesini anlatıyor. Lucia Caminos, serinin üç boyutlu evrenindeki ilk kadın ana karakter olarak yer alıyor.
Hikaye, ABD'nin Florida eyaletinden esinlenilen kurgusal Leonida eyaletinde ve Miami'yi temel alan Vice City şehrinde geçiyor.
Öte yandan Pelin Akil , birkaç ay önce Empati programında Anıl Altan'ın babalığı ile ilgili "Çocuklarımın çok ilgili bir babaları olduğu için çok mutluyum. Ben öncelikle çocuklarım için çok iyi bir baba bulmuşum. Bundan dolayı çok mutluyum, iyi ki ondan çocuklarım var" demişti.

Bir süredir ABD'de yaşayan fenomen Eylül Öztürk, yüzündeki değişimden rahatsızlık duyduğu için estetik operasyon geçirdi. Yaklaşık 5 saat süren ameliyatta dört farklı işlem yaptıran Öztürk, bandajlarını çıkardıktan sonra yeni görüntüsüyle kamera karşısına geçti.
Yüzünün çöktüğünü düşündüğünü anlatan Eylül Öztürk, farklı doktorlarla görüştükten sonra ameliyatını Türkiye'de yaptırmaya karar verdi. Fenomen, operasyon öncesinde orta yüz germe, "fox eye" olarak bilinen göz çektirme, göz kapağı estetiği ve dudak kaldırma işlemlerinden geçeceğini açıklamıştı.
Yaklaşık 5 saat süren ameliyatın ardından yüzü bandajlı halde görüntülenen Öztürk, iyileşme sürecini de takipçileriyle paylaştı.
Ameliyatın altıncı gününde kuaföre giden fenomen, saçlarını boyattı ve kaynak saç taktırdı. Yeni saçlarıyla birlikte estetik operasyon sonrası değişen yüz hatlarını da gösteren Öztürk'ün özellikle göz çevresi, kaşları ve dudaklarındaki farklılık dikkat çekti.
Ameliyatının yedinci gününde dikişleri alınan Öztürk, yüzündeki şişliklerin henüz tamamen geçmediğini belirtti. İyileşme sürecinin devam ettiğini söyleyen fenomen, "Şu an kaşlarım oldukça kalkık, gözlerim fazlasıyla çekik ve yüzümde hala şişlikler var. Ancak önümüzdeki haftalarda bunların azalmasını ve görüntümün çok daha doğal bir hal almasını bekliyorum." dedi.
Öztürk, ameliyatının 30. gününde son görünümünü yeniden paylaşacağını da duyurdu.
Eylül Öztürk'ün kapsamlı operasyonunun maliyeti de merak konusu oldu. Fenomenin estetik işlemler için yaklaşık 100 bin dolar ödediği ileri sürüldü. Ancak ünlü fenomen iddiaları yalanladı.

Hollywood yapımlarında rol alan eski profesyonel beyzbolcu ve oyuncu Lance Broadway'den acı haber geldi. Olympus Has Fallen, Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. ve Lucifer gibi yapımlarda izleyici karşısına çıkan Broadway, ABD'nin Teksas eyaletinde bulunan bir apartmanın merdiven boşluğunda ölü bulundu. Henüz 43 yaşında olan oyuncunun beklenmedik ölümüyle ilgili inceleme başlatıldı.
Lance Broadway'in cansız bedeni, 17 Kasım Salı günü Dallas kentinde Love Field Havalimanı yakınlarındaki bir apartman kompleksinde bulundu. Yerel polis, saat 18.40 sıralarında yapılan acil çağrı üzerine olay yerine ekiplerin sevk edildiğini bildirdi.
Dallas Adli Tıp Kurumunun kayıtlarına göre Broadway'in ölüm nedeni henüz belirlenemedi. Kesin sonucun yapılacak incelemelerin ardından ortaya çıkması bekleniyor.
Ünlü oyuncunun ölümünden önceki son Instagram paylaşımını 7 Kasım'da yaptığı öğrenildi. Broadway, paylaşımında futbol oynayan yeğeninin fotoğraflarına yer vermiş ve onun tarzıyla ilgili esprili ifadeler kullanmıştı.
Oyuncunun bu paylaşımından 10 gün sonra hayatını kaybettiği ortaya çıktı.
1983 yılında Teksas'ta dünyaya gelen Lance Broadway, kariyerine profesyonel beyzbolcu olarak başladı. Chicago White Sox ve New York Mets takımlarında forma giyen Broadway, spor kariyerinin ardından oyunculuğa yöneldi.
2013 yılında Gerard Butler ve Morgan Freeman'ın başrollerini paylaştığı Olympus Has Fallen filminde gizli servis ajanını canlandıran Broadway, daha sonra Marvel yapımı Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., Lucifer ve Colony gibi dizilerde rol aldı.
Broadway'in ölümüne ilişkin adli inceleme sürerken yetkililer henüz kesin bir ölüm nedeni açıklamadı.

ANTALYA'da COP31'e özel hazırlanan TOLGSHOW'da sahne alan Tolga Çevik , 'Arkadaşım' karakteriyle izleyicilere eğlenceli anlar yaşatırken, iklim değişikliği ve çevre bilincine ilişkin mesajlar da verdi. İlginin yoğun olduğu gösterinin ardından Çevik, iklim elçileriyle bir araya gelerek fotoğraf çektirdi.
COP31'deki Yeşil Bölge'de düzenlenen kültür-sanat etkinlikleri, sanat dünyasından isimleri ağırlamayı sürdürüyor. Zirvenin 11'inci günüde komedyen Tolga Çevik , COP31'e özel hazırlanan TOLGSHOW ile izleyicilerin karşısına çıktı. Çevik'in ücretsiz gösterisini izlemek isteyen ziyaretçiler ve katılımcılar, Kongre Merkezi önünde uzun kuyruklar oluşturdu. Mizahın yanı sıra iklim değişikliği ve COP31'in önemine de değinilen mesajların yer aldığı gösteri, izleyicilerin beğenisini kazandı. Gösteri sonunda Tolga Çevik , iklim elçisi gençler hatıra fotoğrafı çektirdi.
Basın mensuplarının sorularını yanıtlayan Çevik, COP31'in farklı ülkelerden insanları ortak bir amaç etrafında buluşturmasının önemine dikkat çekerek, "Bütün insanlığı bir araya toplayıp güzel şeyler yapmaya çalışmak benim için çok kıymetli. Dizi 22 Eylül Salı akşamı Total'de 3,32 ile dördüncü, AB 'de 2,42 ile yedinci, ABC1'de 3,07 ile altıncı sırada yer aldı ve ikinci sezonun 5. bölümünde final yapma kararı bu reytinglerin ardından verildi. Owen Cooper from Warrington stars in the new music video for the Beatles song In My Life
Award-winning actor Owen Cooper has starred in a new music video for The Beatles , external song In My Life.
The video for the newly mixed track, from the band's 1965 album Rubber Soul, celebrates their hometown of Liverpool.
The Warrington-born star appears in the film, which features Liverpool landmarks including the Royal Liver Building, Liverpool Cathedral, Royal Albert Dock and Strawberry Field.
Cooper, 16, is best known for his role in Netflix drama Adolescence, for which he won an Emmy Award.
Directed by Jessica Swale and Irina Alexiu, the video tells the story of a ukulele that connects generations of one family through a shared love of music.
A scene outside Woolton Picture House pays tribute to the band's famous Abbey Road album cover, while another recalls George Harrison's fall in the opening sequence of A Hard Day's Night.
It follows Apple Corps' announcement that the Beatles Story attraction will move to the former St John's Market site, due to open in 2028. The plans also include a Yellow Submarine-themed viewing experience at St Johns Beacon.
Owen Cooper holds his award after winning Supporting Actor for Adolescence
Owen Cooper previously paid tribute to John Lennon and The Beatles as he collected a Bafta Television Award for Adolescence in May 2026.
"In the words of John Lennon, you won't get anything unless you have the vision to imagine it."

Etkisini şimdiden görmeye başladığımız bu Dolunay’ın en belirgin özelliği, Dolunay’a Uranüs ’ün de eşlik etmesi.
Uranüs; sürprizleri, ani gelişmeleri, planları altüst eden ya da tam tersine hızlandıran beklenmedik durumları temsil ediyor.
Dolayısıyla önümüzdeki günlerde hayatımızda hiç hesapta olmayan ani kararların ve şaşırtıcı gelişmelerin kapımızı çalmasına şaşırabiliriz.
​ İkizler burcu zihinsel hareketliliği, iletişimi, ticari işleri, eğitimleri ve yakın çevremizle olan diyalogları yönetiyor.
Bu Dolunay, Uranüs’ün de etkisiyle zihnimizi adeta serbest bırakıyor.
Günlük rutinlerimizden sıkıldığımız, uzun süredir tıkandığımız konularda ani değişiklikler yapabilir, radikal kararlar alabiliriz .
Beklenmedik bir seyahat teklifi, ani bir iş fırsatı ya da uzun süredir çözülemeyen bir meselenin bir anda çözülmesi bu dönemin ana temaları arasında yer alıyor.
​Dolunay’ın Plüton ve Neptün ile kuracağı olumlu açı ise bu değişimlerin yıkıcı değil, aksine yapıcı ve dönüştürücü olacağını gösteriyor.
Hayatımızda kökten yenilemek istediğimiz ama bir türlü cesaret edemediğimiz alanlarda Plüton bize içsel bir güç veriyor.
Artık bize hizmet etmeyen eski alışkanlıklarımızı geride bırakıp, daha özgür ve yenilikçi adımlara doğru ilerliyoruz.
Bu Dolunay özellikle iletişim, teknoloji, medya, yazılı işler, ticaret ve eğitim alanlarında büyük fırsatlar barındırıyor.
Dijital dünyada iş yapanlar, yeni projeler geliştirenler veya kendini ifade etmek isteyenler için kapılar aralanıyor.
Beklemediğimiz yerlerden gelen teklifler bu dönemin en dikkat çekici detayını oluşturuyor; çünkü bu süreçte karşımıza çıkan şanslar genellikle en ummadığımız anlarda beliriyor.
Her ne kadar Dolunay yenilikler ve sürprizler vadediyor olsa da gökyüzündeki Mars’ın sert açısı işin diğer boyutunu gözler önüne seriyor.
Bu görünüm; hayatımızda aksiyon artarken aynı zamanda sabırsızlık, gerilim, anlık tartışmalar ve iletişim problemlerinin de tetiklenebileceği bir döngüye işaret ediyor. Sözlerin sivrilebileceği, yanlış anlaşılmaların hızla büyüyebileceği bu süreçte, fevri çıkışlardan kaçınmak ve enerjimizi yapıcı projelere yönlendirmek büyük önem taşıyor.
Bu Dolunay, toplumsal düzeyde de hareketli gelişmelere sahne oluyor. Ülkemiz ve dünya gündemi açısından teknoloji, yapay zekâ, ekonomi ve eğitim alanlarında ani düzenlemeler ve beklenmedik gündem değişiklikleri masaya gelebilir.
Öte yandan gökyüzündeki bu yoğun trafik ; hızlı haberleşme ağlarını, havacılık sektörünü ve ani hava olaylarını öne çıkarıyor.
​Özetle; bu Dolunay rutini bozmak, yeni adımlar atmak ve hayatına taze bir soluk getirmek isteyenler için etkileyici bir zemin hazırlıyor.
Sürprizlere açık olduğumuz, ancak olası gerilimleri dengede tutmak için çaba harcayacağımız bir dönem bizi bekliyor.

Charlotte Steele, Holly-Anne Hull and Lauren Byrne (left to right) met as sixth-formers in Hampshire
Remember Monday used to say that representing the UK at the 2025 Eurovision Song Contest was the "scariest" moment of their career.
But an upcoming album and UK tour will send the adrenaline soaring again, according to members Holly-Anne Hull, Charlotte Steele and Lauren Byrne.
"We still feel nerves like it all the time," Hull told BBC Introducing.
The vocal trio have recorded a new session for the programme, which was the first to play their music on the radio in 2019.
Seven years on, their credits include festivals, singles and the Eurovision final, where they came 19th out of 28 countries.
"About a month later, we were performing at Wembley Stadium and we were like, 'I can't take it'," Byrne recalled.
"The coolest rock star story ever": Remember Monday meet McFly
The gig, in front of 80,000 people, led to a high-profile 2026 tour with pop-rock group McFly.
"Our dressing room was next to theirs at Wembley Stadium," Hull told presenter Steph Nieuwenhuys on BBC Introducing Hampshire, Dorset and the Isle of Wight.
"We just hit it off... We just toured the whole summer with them. Their crowds are crazy.
"It's scary being launched brand new into this industry without really knowing what we were doing.
"They've kind of taken us under their wing and been like: 'We'll look after you, you've got this.'"
Remember Monday's debut album, Can We Press Rewind?, is another "terrifying-slash-exciting" moment, according to Byrne.
Pre-released singles include the latest, Dream Cheat, a playful riff on the "relatable" experience of having a nightmare that a partner has been unfaithful.
The close-harmony trio met at The Sixth Form College in Farnborough, Hampshire.
Steele went on to be a founding member of performing arts sixth form Artemis College, in Bracknell, Berkshire, while all three have experience of performing in West End theatre shows.
The group's six-city UK tour in February includes dates in Bristol, Birmingham, London, Portsmouth, Manchester and Glasgow.

Joseph Zada stars as a teenage Haymitch Abernathy in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
It's been 14 years since the release of the first Hunger Games movie, which helped establish the careers of talented young actors Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Tom Blyth and Rachel Zegler.
This latest instalment, prequel film Sunrise on the Reaping, looks to do the same with its leading trio: 21-year-old Joseph Zada, 20-year-old Mckenna Grace and 23-year-old Whitney Peak.
Sitting down with BBC News at the start of a gruelling press run, the group were buzzing with a mixture of anticipation, nerves and excitement ahead of the release of the much-talked-about film.
Zada, who is taking on his first major role as lead Haymitch Abernathy, said they had been "clinging together" and "using each other, making sure we all feel supported".
Grace is the most experienced of the three, having grown up as a child star with appearances in TV series The Handmaid's Tale, The Haunting of Hill House and two of the recent Ghostbusters films.
Even then, she said joining The Hunger Games franchise is "so nerve-racking", adding "I don't think anything can prepare you for working on it - this is nothing like anything I've experienced."
Joseph Zada and Mckenna Grace play District 12 tributes Haymitch Abernathy and Maysilee Donner
Peak, who starred in Netflix's Chilling Adventures of Sabrina, jokes that she and Zada have sought out Grace every time they have felt "stuck or confused about what's happening" while promoting the film, and Zada says she has been a "mentor" to the new actors.
Sunrise on the Reaping is the sixth film in the series, which to date is one of the highest-grossing film franchises of all time, bringing in more than $3.3bn (£2.51bn) worldwide since 2012.
It is set 24 years before the original The Hunger Games film and is based on the 2025 book of the same name by author Suzanne Collins.
Zada takes on the role of a teenage Haymitch, who is played by Woody Harrelson in the original films - a District 12 tribute in the games, chosen alongside Grace's character Donner.
Whitney Peak stars as Haymitch's girlfriend Lenore Dove, who is left behind in District 12 while he fights in the games
Reviews of the latest film have been generally positive, with several outlets praising Zada's performance, noting the difficulty of stepping into Harrelson's shoes.
Zada says he spent months "completely invested" in Harrelson's performances in the first four The Hunger Games films, "watching everything I could find and then making notes" which he used "as a base layer to colour with my own ideas".
He didn't meet the Oscar-nominated actor until halfway through filming, but says his advice was to watch two films - Cool Hand Luke and Harold and Maud, with the former "helping a lot to ground my performance" and the latter serving as "a fun watch".
Jesse Plemons, who plays a games producer in the film, told the BBC he knew Zada's role would be "a massive undertaking" after reading the script but says he was "amazed by his stamina and grace".
This was echoed by Glenn Close, who plays an over-the-top representative from the ruling Capitol, who said she "loved working with" Zada.
"When I met them [Zada, Grace and Peak] for the first time, they'd done all the games and been through it all.
"The first thing Joe said to me was 'I'm a bit traumatised' and he wasn't even done - there was still so much to go," she added.
Glenn Close plays an over-the-top government official from the Capitol in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
The film, which includes an ensemble cast of Ralph Fiennes, Maya Hawke, Kieran Culkin and Elle Fanning, is set during the 50th edition of The Hunger Games - with most elements of the brutal dystopian universe that fans have come to recognise from the previous films returning in this iteration.
Adapted from Collins' novels, the series is set in a post-apocalyptic North America, which is known as Panem, with the first trilogy focusing on a teenage Katniss Everdeen, who was played by Lawrence in the films.
Panem has 12 districts that participate in the yearly Hunger Games, produced and run by the governing area, the Capitol, as a punishment for rebellion.
Peak notes that being on set was an intense experience for the young cast and could "get overwhelming very quickly" on set, so they had to make sure to "keep it light between all the hard stuff".
"I don't think people realise how intensely bonding an experience like this is because we all spend days doing extremely physical and deeply emotional things," Grace says.
"It's like a little family on set; we've all been thankful to have each other," she added.

Further job losses and programme cuts at the BBC will be more noticeable to audiences than previous savings measures, a new report has warned.
The corporation announced plans earlier this year to cut about 1,800 roles and close some programmes and services, but it has further savings to make to reach its £500m target.
In its report, the National Audit Office (NAO) anticipated the BBC's next round of cost-cutting measures would be more difficult to deliver and more perceptible to audiences.
The BBC welcomed the report, saying it had "consistently argued that the current funding model is not sustainable and needs reform".
The NAO report , external also said the BBC's current measures were expected to reduce the BBC's workforce by 11% over three years.
Gareth Davies, head of the NAO, said: "As the BBC approaches charter renewal in just over a year's time, there is no doubt that there are difficult choices ahead."
The BBC's finances have declined in recent years as a result of falling licence fee income and rising production costs.
The organisation has so far achieved savings by reducing staffing levels, rationalising its estate, modernising technology, simplifying processes and changing the mix and scope of content and services, the public spending watchdog said.
BBC director-general Matt Brittin previously described the licence fee model as a "busted flush"
The NAO found the BBC's licence fee income had fallen by 26% in real terms over the last decade, because in part of the significant changes in audience habits.
The proportion of UK adults using BBC television, iPlayer, radio or online services on an average week also fell from 90% in 2021-22 to 81% in 2025-26, the NAO said.
The report noted the corporation's public service broadcasting operating deficit had reached £209m in the last financial year.
The BBC has already announced plans to reduce spending by about 10%, including cuts to programming across its news, nations and content divisions.
Celebrity Mastermind, Blankety Blank, Live At The Apollo, Football Focus, Ski Sunday and RuPaul's Drag Race UK are among the TV programmes to have been cut so far.
Radio programmes are also being dropped from the schedules, such as BBC Radio 4's You and Yours, and The World Tonight.
The corporation has also announced plans to close the linear broadcast services of BBC Radio 4 Extra, BBC Three and BBC Scotland, with the latter two becoming online-only services.
The NAO said the BBC expected to face difficult choices about the scale and scope of its services as part of its latest savings programme, with further content reductions expected to have a greater impact on audiences.
It warned the corporation was likely to find it harder to identify further savings following its previous cost-cutting programmes.
The NAO also found the broadcaster had not properly monitored the cumulative impact of its previous savings on audiences, service quality and organisational capability.
It also raised concerns about the BBC's risk management and governance arrangements, and said stronger oversight would be needed to deliver the more demanding savings programme.
In response to the report, the BBC said it welcomed the findings, adding that it had had to "make tough decisions due to sustained financial pressures driven by declining licence fee income, changing audience behaviour, increased competition and rising costs".
Berangere Michel, the BBC's group chief financial officer, said: "We welcome this report and are pleased that the NAO has acknowledged the significant savings already delivered by the BBC, with the programme on track to meet its target one year ahead of schedule.
"The BBC must respond to significant cost pressures while reinventing for a changing world. This continues to require tough decisions, while ensuring that the impacts on audiences and colleagues are minimised.
"We accept the NAO's recommendations and have already begun implementing them to strengthen the delivery of our current savings programme, while recognising there are further opportunities to build on this progress."
She added: "We will continue to engage with government to secure a new Charter that provides sufficient, sustainable and universal funding so the BBC can deliver for audiences for generations to come."

texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/vid: Arsenal fall to a 2-0 defeat against a superior Lyon side in the Women's Champions League, dealing a blow to their hopes of automatic quarter-final qualification.
texts.https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/art:
Arsenal goalkeeper Misa Rodriguez made six saves but was beaten twice in defeat by Lyon
It is only 18 months since Arsenal tasted European glory, but they are not a team on many people's list of favourites for this season's Women's Champions League.
That is because not only have the Gunners disappointed across their opening 15 matches of the season, but also the elite teams in Europe seem to have gone up another level.
In the space of seven days, Arsenal have witnessed first hand what it takes to reach those heights - and the gap they must bridge.
Last week, they were resilient at Barcelona to earn a very respectable 1-1 draw, but were fortunate the Spanish side were not clinical with their chances at Camp Nou.
On Thursday night, they were outplayed at home in losing 2-0 to an excellent Lyon side , who look on course to match or better their runner-up finish from last season.
One point from such games could be pleasing - but that only shows the work Arsenal need to do to be considered one of the top teams in Europe.
French giants Lyon outclass Arsenal in Women's Champions League
Arsenal came into Thursday's defeat by Lyon off the back of a fifth successive Women's Super League draw at Emirates Stadium against London City Lionesses.
In contrast, Lyon have been flying domestically, winning all nine of their matches, scoring 49 goals, and then not conceding any in their unbeaten Champions League run.
Such form sets the pace and it was clear at Meadow Park that they were superior to Arsenal in every department.
Vibrant Germany international Jule Brand gave them the lead midway through the first half and Melchie Dumornay sealed the win with a powerful strike in the 57th minute.
Arsenal defender Leah Williamson said the "better team won the game" and manager Renee Slegers highlighted the difference in physicality between the teams.
"Compared to last year when we played Lyon [in the semi-finals], they are even better now. They have standout individual quality," Slegers said.
"They dominated in the first half. We had solutions for the second half and had more presence. We wore them down better but it still didn't lead to open chances."
Despite playing at right-back, Jule Brand had the third most touches in the Arsenal penalty area for Lyon (five) after striker Marie-Antoinette Katoto and fellow goalscorer Melchie Dumornay
Lyon had a 3.33 expected goals ratio on Thursday, serving up 23 shots to Arsenal's seven. They created six big chances and 14 of their shots were inside the box.
Dumornay oozed quality, midfielder Lily Yohannes showed composure and Brand was very impressive both defensively and going forward for Lyon, deployed in a new position.
Those individuals have benefitted from the expertise of former Barcelona manager Jonatan Giraldez, who joined in June 2025 - the month after Arsenal won the Champions League - and has now had the time he needed to impose his style.
As a result, Lyon have gone up another level and the gap between these two teams has widened by Arsenal's drop-off this season.
Slegers also said Arsenal had "prepared all we could" for the intensity that Lyon brought in London - but it still did not have an impact.
Asked how far off Lyon they currently are, Slegers said: "It's 2-0 today and they are better than us but it doesn't mean if we were to play them again soon, this season, that it would be the same game again.
"We saw moments where we did well and we know from the last couple of years we can hurt Lyon.
"But for today, their pace and physicality helped them get too much dominance in the game and that is one of their strengths. Then it became hard for us."
Arsenal have not yet qualified for the knockout stages of the Champions League
Williamson said Arsenal "know what they need to do to be better" and that they are aware of "where the gaps are" to Europe's elite.
They are already 12 points off the pace in the Women's Super League title race and are unlikely to qualify automatically for the Champions League quarter-finals.
"The level rises year on year. Everybody cops goals - we have to try not to and we have to create," said Williamson following the defeat by Lyon.
"We're all focused and we're all together. That's the most comforting thing for me - but this has been a tough period."
It has not all been bad despite disappointing results - and context is important.
Over a gruelling seven days, they have faced European holders Barcelona, WSL high-flyers London City Lionesses and record Champions League winners Lyon.
They showed grit and resilience out in Barcelona last week - traits that have not been on show enough for Arsenal this season, but are clearly there.
Players like Williamson, striker Alessia Russo and summer signings Georgia Stanway and Ona Batlle know what it takes to compete at the highest level.
Arsenal invested in the summer transfer window and brought in proven, experienced players, but that has not translated into results - yet.
Giraldez said time with his players has helped improve Lyon and perhaps that is what Arsenal need - patience.
"I think they are changing now. They made a good game against Barcelona and it's very difficult to go there and get a point," said Giraldez.
"The game against London City was much better. It's not just about them, but also about us. Now we have improved and play better football than last year.
"I think it is a matter of time [for Arsenal]. They have a good coach and good players. In general, they have all the ingredients to have a good season."

The match between Spain and England took place at Atletico Madrid's Metropolitano stadium
England have been punished by Uefa following anti-Catholic chanting from the away fans during their Nations League victory in Spain.
European football's governing body have fined the Football Association £12,572 (15,000 euros) and imposed a suspended one-match ban for England away supporters.
BBC Sport understands the charge of 'racist and/or discriminatory behaviour' relates to chants that were deemed anti-Catholic and anti-Irish.
"We will not tolerate this unacceptable and deeply offensive chanting, and will work with the police, who attend all England home and away matches, to identify the perpetrators and take the necessary action," an FA spokesperson said.
A further offence within the next two years would mean a ban on away fans is enforced.
There had been concerns of the prospect of racist chanting from Spain fans before the game in Madrid with England boss Thomas Tuchel stating he would remind his players of Uefa's anti-racism protocol before the fixture.
Tuchel stressed he didn't expect any incidents, but the visit was England's first to the Spanish capital since a notorious 2004 encounter at the Bernabeu was overshadowed by racist chanting directed at their players.
That led to a firm response from Spain head coach Luis de la Fuente, who said: "What I'd tell you, and you can tell Thomas, is that in Spain, there's no racism.
"Just like that, crystal clear. Just like in England, there's no racism in Spain. We aren't racist, any of us."
England won the match 3-2 to end Spain's 43-match unbeaten run and top League A Group 3.

Thomas Frank has admitted he has a point to prove on his return to management as he aims to steer Crystal Palace away from relegation trouble after taking over from Pierre Sage.
The Dane was confirmed as manager on Monday with Palace at the bottom of the table after 10 matches having conceded 24 goals – the most in the Premier League. They face a crucial trip to Coventry on Saturday and Frank said he had been “surprised about how good it feels” after returning to work for the first time since being sacked by ­ Tottenham in February .
The 53-year-old spent most of the intervening period travelling, working as a pundit at the World Cup and taking in trips to Japan, Australia and his native Denmark, where he was visiting friends and family when he received the SOS call from Palace last week. Frank previously spent seven years in charge of Brentford but left Spurs after just eight months with a win ratio of 34.2% – the worst of any permanent manager in the club’s history. He believes he has learned from that experience.
“I think you’ve all got an ego,” he said. “Some are better at controlling it than others. For me, it’s not the critics. It’s more what I can bring myself, what I can learn, what I can prove, how I can get better. I think that’s the big thing.
“In this world there’s a lot of clever people out there. But they only know a 10th of the truth. And that’s a 10th of the truth at Brentford and a 10th of the truth at Tottenham. That’s just the way it is – if you can’t handle that as a coach or a player or whatever, then you shouldn’t be in this business. I’m just very happy to be back in the game, very happy to be in a fantastic club, at Palace, where you walk in the door and you just feel the energy. You feel the people. It just feels good.”
Frank said he is planning to pick Roy Hodgson’s brains in the coming days after recalling a conversation they had when the former England and Palace manager was still at Selhurst Park.
“I was thinking, does it ever go away? The worry, do you get more relaxed about everything?” he asked Hodgson. “‘No chance, it’s impossible.’ I thought it would have been a little bit easier with age and experience. But in a way can’t help ourselves. I know what I want and the direction we should go in.”
Justin Cochrane – one of Thomas Tuchel’s assistants for England – has joined as first-team coach and took his first session with Palace on Monday less than 24 hours after the Nations League victory over Spain in Madrid. He is expected to be joined on Palace’s backroom staff by Bernardo Cueva, with Frank confirming that a deal with Chelsea is “very close” for the Mexican. Both worked with Frank at Brentford, where he spent almost nine years as an assistant and then manager. He is also hoping to add Andreas Georgson from Tottenham, who has been credited for his prowess on set-pieces: an area that Palace have struggled with for some time.
But asked whether he will be judged on the perception that his success at Brentford was based on the model that has allowed his successor, Keith Andrews, to thrive since taking over, Frank was not impressed. “Put it this way, I think it was pretty important in terms of building that model,” he said.

Thomas Frank replaces Frenchman Pierre Sage at Crystal Palace
Thomas Frank is happy to be "back in the circus" after speaking at his first news conference as Crystal Palace manager.
The 53-year-old, who was appointed on a two-and-a-half-year deal on Monday, has been out of work since he was sacked by Tottenham in February, less than eight months after taking the job.
But, rather than dwell on that disappointment, Frank hopes to use it as a learning exeprience as he attempts to improve Palace's fortunes and lift them off the bottom of the Premier League table.
"If you don't learn from any of your jobs, I don't think you reflect, I don't think you improve, and I don't think you get better," said Frank.
"Of course there's a lot of things I have been reflecting over. The details, that will be for another time, but I can say I've learned, definitely."
The Dane said he could easily have extended his break from football, which he used to travel to Japan and Australia, as well as "visiting friends and family, eating too well [and] drinking too much wine" back in his homeland.
"I was very aware I didn't want to do anything in the summer. I put a statement out there, I needed more time," he added.
"I can actually, honestly say I would have been fine if it was three, four, five, six, seven months more, because it's good to be back in the circus, but it's also unbelievably good not to be in, especially if you enjoy life, which I do.
"I was spending time with family and friends and doing all that, but I think the club, the way Palace is, how well Steve Parish especially spoke about the club and ideas, Matt Hobbs and Iain Moody and these guys, too, helped convince me it was a good idea.
"I'm a little bit surprised by this feeling I have in the body, how good it feels."
Frank's Palace reign begins with a trip to Coventry City on Saturday (15:00 GMT) and he says he returns to the dugout unbruised despite the way his stint at Spurs ended.
"I think we all have an ego," the former Brentford boss said. "Some are better at controlling it than others. For me, it's not the critics, it's more what I can learn, what I can prove, how I can get better.
"There's a lot of clever people out there, but the interesting thing is they only know 10 per cent of the truth. That's a tenth of the truth at Brentford , there's a tenth of the truth at Tottenham , and that's just the way it is.
"If you can't handle that as a coach or a player, then you shouldn't be in this business, and I'm very happy to be back in the game."

Steve Evans criticised his Bristol Rovers players last week after a disappointing 2-0 loss to Chesterfield left them 18th in the League Two table
The Championship resumes this weekend - but not all will be as it was.
Blackburn Rovers and Swansea City dip their feet into life without Tony Mowbray and Vitor Matos at their sides, for very different reasons.
Meanwhile, Bristol Rovers boss Steve Evans remains in charge in League Two but, given his comments after their last game, it might not be a relationship built to last.
Here are five things to capture your attention this EFL weekend.
Tony Mowbray (right) has left Blackburn Rovers in 13th place in the table while Vitor Matos (left) departs for France with Swansea City in sixth
It would have been a crushing blow to Blackburn fans to lose boss Mowbray, who stepped away due to ill health on Tuesday.
The veteran was surprising the league with a competitive Rovers side only three points away from the top eight and last registering a shock 2-1 win over big dogs West Ham United.
Rovers are not looking for an immediate successor and Mowbray may yet resume his managerial duties at some point, but the side will want to ensure they keep their fine form going rather than leaving him a salvage job to pull off should he return.
To do so, the team will have to put their concerns aside and focus on the job at hand - a Lancashire derby with struggling Burnley at Turf Moor on Sunday (12:00 GMT).
But they are not the only team to be without their trusty manager.
Matos has spread his wings to fly over to Strasbourg and leaves his Swans in a healthy league position but also in poor form.
The Welsh side have lost four of their past five (W1) to begin falling down the pecking order but still remain inside the play-off places, three points below the league leaders and three above West Ham in ninth.
Matos has taken four members of his coaching staff with him, meaning former Swans players Joe Allen and Ashley Williams have stepped in as a makeshift coaching set-up before a difficult game against fifth-placed West Bromwich Albion on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
"Swansea were doing great but I felt they were performing at their absolute maximum," former Stoke full-back Tommy Smith told the 72+ podcast this week.
"I think it's a good opportunity for him, a good opportunity for Strasbourg but it's a tough one for Swansea to take."
Millwall have won their past three home fixtures against London rivals QPR
Queens Park Rangers boss Julien Stephan believes their London derby against Millwall on Saturday lunchtime (12:30 GMT) will be the first of five games to truly define his side .
The R's are going strong so far this season. They sit inside the play-off positions, five points off the league leaders but it's not enough yet to convince everyone they have finally become promotion contenders after 12 years mostly in the doldrums.
"The thing that is going to hold us back is consistency," QPR fan Gareth Dixon told BBC Radio London .
"We have far too many players injured too frequently. Getting that first, strongest XI is a challenge for us.
"If we can get our strongest team out, if we can keep the performances up then we are looking at top eight."
Millwall, meanwhile, know what it's like to push for a place in the Premier League in recent times, but things have not panned out so well this season.
Injuries have hampered them and after only two wins in their past 10 league games, both against teams in the bottom three, the Lions' season is yet to really get going.
All three of the Championship clubs based in the West Midlands plus Staffordshire's Stoke City are within one point of each other at the top of the table
There is something in the air around the western side of the Midlands.
Only Middlesbrough disrupt a top five of West Midlands and Staffordshire clubs and the two best of that bunch are league leaders Birmingham City and third-placed Stoke City.
Both are on three-match winning streaks and sit on 29 points, separated merely by Blues' superior goal difference.
Saturday's game at the Bet365 Stadium (15:00 GMT) will see the two go head-to-head for a top-two spot - and possibly top spot itself.
But a draw could open the door for either Wolves or West Bromwich Albion to reach the summit instead.
Dave Challinor was announced as new Sheffield Wednesday boss on 1 November
In a game against fellow promotion contenders Plymouth Argyle last weekend, Sheffield Wednesday claimed a convincing 3-0 victory to mark Dave Challinor's return to League One management.
Their next opponent, Barnsley, seem like they will be an easier ride. The Tykes have the joint fewest points in the league with nine, kept off the bottom through goal difference alone.
A derby under the lights can produce something special though.
Barnsley have won both their previous matches against Wednesday and will be seeking a third in a row for the first time since 1946.
No one is expecting the Tykes to claim all three points when they meet on Friday night (20:00 GMT) but that means all the pressure is on the rebuilding Wednesday side.
The Owls did not deal so well with that expectation in the two cup games Challinor began his reign with, losing in the FA Cup to Oldham Athletic and suffering a 4-0 drubbing in the EFL Trophy against Accrington Stanley.
Can they rise to the occasion or is it Barnsley's time to get motoring?
Few bosses in League Two have the experience of Steve Cotterill and Steve Evans
Cheltenham Town boss Steve Cotterill isn't much loved by the Bristol Rovers fan base.
The 62-year-old led the Gas' local rivals Bristol City to the League One title and the EFL Trophy in 2015, earning the Robins' eternal admiration and Rovers' unrelenting dislike.
However, back at his boyhood club, Cotterill will be aiming to quieten his critics among the away support as he looks to take Cheltenham into the League Two play-off spots when the two sides face each other on Saturday (15:00 GMT).
His current Robins have lost five of their past seven games (W2) but still remain just a point shy of the top seven.
Rovers, meanwhile, are tumbling down the table at a rapid rate after a seven-game winless run where they have taken just one point - and they are hardly putting up a united front.
Manager Steve Evans has suggested he will depart the club if he feels they no longer want his services and has placed blame on his players for their run of poor form.
"You're going to Steve Cotterill's Cheltenham side, who are very good, particularly at Whaddon Road," Evans told BBC Radio Bristol after their loss to Chesterfield last weekend.
"We have to pick a team first and foremost that works hard and fights.
"I'll still turn up at 6.30 in the morning. I'll still leave at 6 o'clock at night. I still go and watch the opposition, do the analysis. What's changed? I know what's changed – inconsistent players."

England have been handed a ­suspended ­one-match ban on away ticket sales by Uefa in relation to “­racist and/or ­discriminatory” behaviour by fans at Sunday’s 3-2 Nations League victory over Spain. The punishment is suspended for two years.
Uefa has also fined the Football Association €15,000 (£12,500), with the behaviour in question believed to be the chant of “Fuck the pope and the IRA” at the ­Metropolitano ­Stadium in Madrid. A further charge in the next two years could trigger a ban on away fans for a competitive game.
In a statement given to the Mail, the FA said: “We will not ­tolerate this unacceptable and deeply ­offensive chanting, and will work with the police who attend all ­England home and away matches to identify the perpetrators and take the necessary action.”
Uefa’s control, ­ethics and ­disciplinary body announced that it had decided “to fine the English ­Football ­Association €15,000 and to order against the ­English Football Association a full ­restriction on selling tickets to its ­supporters for one representative team competition away match, for the ­racist and/or discriminatory ­behaviour of its supporters.
“Said full restriction on selling tickets to supporters for one away match is suspended for a ­probationary period of two years, starting from the date of the present decision.”

Past years suggest it is tough to make big positional gains after slow start but that someone now safe will be relegated
T he Premier League is about to enter the most intense phase of its season. After 10 rounds of fixtures across the past three months there are 10 in the next seven weeks. Yet if you hibernated for winter, most clubs would be in roughly the same position no matter when in spring you emerged.
Across the past decade, Premier League teams’ positions changed by an average of 2.6 places between matchweeks 10 and 38. Only 5.5 clubs per season moved by more than three places over the final 28 games, with almost half of the teams (89 out of 200) shifting by a single spot at most. Every club other than Arsenal will be looking to improve their position but they need not trouble themselves too much. History shows they will probably finish 2026-27 close to their current standing.
There have inevitably been outliers. Tottenham have tumbled by at least 10 places after matchweek 10 in the past two seasons and Newcastle (in 2021-22), Crystal Palace and Everton (both 2017-18) have risen from the relegation zone at this point to the safety of mid-table by May.
But even moving one position across the remainder of the season can make an enormous difference to a team on the fringe of the Champions League qualification spots, or to those that sit 17th or 18th after 10 games. Not since 2006-07 have the bottom three clubs with 28 matches to go all been relegated.
This fact feels especially relevant this season given two of the three teams in the drop zone have changed their manager since the previous round of matches. Sunderland have stood by Régis Le Bris but he is the favourite to be the next Premier League manager to leave their post. If we can reasonably assume at least one of the clubs currently 18th to 20th will be in the top flight in 2027-28, which is best placed to survive?
It is going to be very tough for Crystal Palace. Opta’s underlying data model implies they are where they deserve to be in the table, whereas Manchester United and Sunderland should be much higher. The largest improvement Palace’s new manager, Thomas Frank , engineered between weeks 10 and 38 at Brentford was two places, which will not cut it this season. Palace have to take inspiration from the 2024-25 season, in which they also had seven points after 10 games yet rose to finish 12th.
Mauricio Pochettino’s Chelsea were 11th going into their 11th game in 2023-24 before ending sixth. As they were also 11th in early April, they made a much shorter dash to the finish line, though. Pochettino’s teams usually improve as campaigns wear on, with Tottenham rising three places after week 10 in each of his first three seasons with the club. A similar lift in his new role would not make this season a rousing success for United but it would stave off the unthinkable idea of relegation.
For someone to escape, someone else must take their place. Ignoring the possibility that the answer to “who?” may be Manchester City, the team in 17th are inevitably the ones most at risk. Of the 13 sides in the past decade who were outside the drop zone after 10 games but went down, six were fourth-bottom going into matchweek 11.
Given that the points gap between first and 20th (20) was last lower at this stage in 2015-16, those figures may be more pertinent than position this season. Leeds in 2022-23 and Bournemouth three years earlier had 13 points after 10 games but were relegated, as did Blackpool in 2010-11 and Middlesbrough two seasons before them.
Only nine clubs are now above that bar, with Aston Villa, Newcastle and Tottenham among those who are not. The table is unlikely to change too much before the end of the campaign but there is a distinct chance that a secure-looking side will perish.

Trey Nyoni scored his first Liverpool goal earlier this month
Trey Nyoni knew this was the season when opportunity beckoned for him at Liverpool .
With Curtis Jones leaving for Inter Milan and the club deciding not to buy another midfielder, Nyoni saw the prospect of regular first-team action if he impressed new head coach Andoni Iraola in pre-season.
First impressions matter. So on the day he returned from a holiday in Morocco in June, Nyoni went from the airport to a personal training session in Leicester - where the 19-year-old grew up and where his family are still based.
Nyoni sought the help of a private football coaching operation as he targeted off-season gains before joining up again with Liverpool .
Coach Steve Stavrou and his son Emillio have also worked with players including Harvey Barnes and Haji Wright. Nyoni asked to work on line-breaking passes, getting away from pressure and improving his finishing.
"We merely supplemented the ability he's already got. He's a quiet and humble lad but knows his ability on the pitch and plays with such a confidence," Emillio Stavrou tells BBC Sport.
Under Iraola, Nyoni has thrived after a stellar pre-season, making 13 appearances already, just one shy of his total appearances last season.
Earlier this month, he scored his first goal for the club in Istanbul.
Liverpool ultimately lost to Fenerbahce in the Champions League that night and Nyoni's belief that "the night has been ruined" showed his inner competitiveness.
His first Premier League start came against last season's champions Arsenal on 1 November.
Nyoni fouled Arsenal 's captain early on, leading one source to remark: "He's a nice kid but you saw that steel too with the way he went into Martin Odegaard."
Perhaps the most significant praise came from Liverpool legend Steven Gerrard, who said he couldn't see why Iraola was taking Nyoni off just before the hour mark in that game.
Iraola was managing Nyoni's workload, with the midfielder playing 85 minutes three days later in Turkey.
"He has to continue in the same place he has been since pre-season: being ready for every game. He is playing all the games lately - so we trust him," said Iraola.
That speaks volumes of Nyoni's rise since joining from Leicester City in 2023 and making his Liverpool debut under Jurgen Klopp as a 16-year-old.
Nyoni, whose parents have Zimbabwean heritage and support Liverpool , is in advanced talks over a new deal.
Having made his England Under-21 debut last week, this is turning into a breakout season with club and country.
In the summer window, the average spend on a player signed from another Premier League club was £39.4m.
Judging by Liverpool 's recent signings - the likes of Alexander Isak (£125m), Bradley Barcola (£123m) and Florian Wirtz (£116m) - there is a sense of satisfaction at the club when the likes of Rio Ngumoha and Nyoni, who cost a fraction of those sums, emerge as first-team options for years to come.
A tribunal decided that Liverpool had to pay Chelsea up to £6.8m in compensation for Ngumoha. In Nyoni's case, Liverpool paid just under £1m in compensation to Leicester.
Nottingham Forest were linked with a £30m move for Nyoni in the summer. Forest denied making the bid, while Liverpool were not interested in a sale.
Iraola saw enough over pre-season to know the teenager would play a prominent part in the new campaign. He only got 237 minutes last season under Arne Slot but has already played 619 minutes this time around.
Slot saw the potential of Nyoni, who trained regularly with the first team. But, given Liverpool 's struggles in 2025-26, the Dutchman was reluctant to experiment.
Under Iraola, Nyoni is finding his feet in a deeper midfield role than he had been used to, seeing more of the ball.
"I've been playing like a number six. I played there when I was young, but it's a new position for me. I've had to learn a lot in a short space of time," Nyoni told The Inside Scoop. , external
The time he spent before pre-season impressed on the coaches there what a talent Nyoni possessed.
"In the drills, he'd make everything game realistic. Everything was with intent and you see a lot of what he does is with disguise, particularly with his passes," Emillio Stavrou recalls.
With two games a week now the norm for Liverpool , Iraola will continue to rotate his team.
But seeing who he names in midfield against Manchester United on Sunday will be interesting because Nyoni is showing that he can fight for a position alongside the likes of Dominik Szoboszlai, Ryan Gravenberch and Alexis Mac Allister.
Inevitably there is work to be done, particularly in terms of endurance and physicality, in order to cope with the rigours of playing consistently at the top level, but it is so far, so good for Nyoni.
Liverpool and Man Utd fans give predictions ahead of Premier League match
In a similar manner to Ngumoha's emergence last season, Liverpool were keen not to block Nyoni's pathway, and under Iraola he has been given the platform to thrive.
Liverpool are still only an injury away from looking short of options, so getting another midfielder remains a priority for next summer.
Monaco's Lamine Camara and Bournemouth 's Alex Scott are two players of interest.
In the here and now, Nyoni needed this opening. He has come out of his shell and feels a lot more like a part of the squad. That quiet nature is slowly changing and that was visible in an interview he did while on England duty.
Asked how Liverpool are doing by one of the hosts, who supports Manchester United , Nyoni simply responded: "Better than United."
Deep down, there is a young man that backs himself and by all accounts, loves football. Neymar is his favourite player.
"He's obsessed with training and obsessed with getting better. The first session we had with him after he'd just got off the plane tells you about him," adds Emillio Stavrou.
Nyoni told Stavrou's little brother in the summer that he backed himself to play regularly for Liverpool .

Mother and brother of former West Ham and Australia youth team striker Dylan Tombides have partnered with FIFA to raise awareness of testicular cancer; Visit dt38.org to find out more about DT38 Foundation, Dylan's story and advice and guidance about testicular cancer.
Fifteen years on from West Ham striker Dylan Tombides discovering he had testicular cancer at the U17 World Cup, his mother and brother are back at the tournament delivering inspiring, emotional talks to the current generation of players to raise awareness in his honour.
Tombides passed away in April 2014 aged just 20, following a battle with the cancer he was diagnosed with while on international duty with Australia's youth team in Mexico in 2011.
A random drugs test revealed what had originally been misdiagnosed by his GP as a cyst was far more serious. Three years of "really intense chemotherapy" followed, says his mother Tracy.
The DT38 Foundation was set up in his name and, in partnership with FIFA Medical, Tracy and Dylan's brother Taylor are part of the initiative at this year's tournament in Doha to explain to players why regular self-examination matters and how to carry it out.
"Getting the call from FIFA was a massive opportunity and an amazing thing for us and for the charity," says Taylor. "Obviously, it's where Dylan last kind of played healthy before his diagnosis. So to come back to where it all started for us as a family is a grateful honour."
During two weeks of talks to 48 teams, Tracy and Taylor have presented to 1,200 players.
With testicular cancer the most common cancer in males aged 15 to 44 - but highly treatable and in most cases curable when detected early - the importance of the sessions could be life changing.
"It's the number one cause of fatality of cancer in this particular age group," explains Dr Andy Massey, FIFA's Chief Medical Officer, who helped form the partnership and has overseen the provision of free scans to players during the tournament.
"This is one of the biggest things I think I've ever done in my sports medicine career because it has such a reach."
Tracy and Taylor's accounts of Dylan's stories have had a powerful impact on their audiences.
"One of the young players stood in front of me and said, 'I'm so sorry for your loss. I'm sorry your son isn't coming home to you. We are so grateful that you are telling us all about it'," says Tracy, recounting a talk with the Jamaican team. A similarly emotional conversation with the French squad ended in hugs instead of handshakes.
The DT38 Foundation have a campaign called Check One Two, encouraging men to check themselves on the first day of every month. Dylan's nickname 'Didge' also provides an acronym and hashtag for the foundation: Delay Is Deadly, Get Educated.
"Early detection is the difference between dealing with cancer treatment that has a 96 per cent cure rate or the figures drop away very, very quickly if you have to go to round two or round three of chemotherapy," says Tracy, who also encourages men with concerns to "insist on an ultrasound" test.
Tracy and Taylor treasure "messages that we've got from people who say, 'I thought of Dylan's story when I found a lump and I knew not to delay. I had testicular cancer and now I'm cancer-free and Dylan saved my life'."
"That tells us that what we're doing is life-changing for that family, that person," says Tracy.
Taylor believes they can have an impact through generations, too. "The effect is lasting. If we can teach these kids now, we know the next generation, they'll teach their kids and they'll teach their kids and it'll be continuous," he says.
"We're not just affecting one life, we're affecting a whole generation of lives, which is the biggest part of it. Without FIFA, we couldn't touch as many people as we have."
Visit dt38.org to find out more about the DT38 Foundation, Dylan's story and advice and guidance about testicular cancer.

Arsenal register a single shot on target, which came in stoppage-time, as they were outclassed by Lyon at Meadow Park; Jule Brand and Melchie Dumornay scored in each half but the French side could easily have finished with more goals in what was a dominant performance
Arsenal’s hopes of automatic qualification to the Women’s Champions League quarter-finals are hanging by a thread after they were beaten 2-0 at home by a dominant Lyon in foggy conditions.
The French side, who beat Arsenal in the semi-finals last season, got the better of the Gunners again at Meadow Park on Thursday night with goals from Jule Brand and Melchie Dumornay in each half sealing the victory.
Arsenal barely laid a glove on Lyon - who are yet to concede a goal in this season's Champions League - and now sit eighth in the standings, three points adrift of fourth-placed Chelsea, after their first loss in five league phase matches.
Emily Fox registered Arsenal's only shot on target of the game deep in stoppage-time and the home side could easily have conceded a few more had Marie-Antoinette Katoto not spurned two big opportunities.
Arsenal were also indebted to their goalkeeper, Misa, who produced three big saves in the second half to keep out Tabitha Chawinga, Dumornay and Vicki Becho.
Renee Slegers' side, now without a win in three matches in all competitions, are relying on teams above them to drop points in the final round of matches to avoid having to face a play-off match to secure their passage to the quarter-finals.
Meanwhile, Lyon, who currently sit second in the table, have secured a top-four finish with a game to spare after picking up 13 points from five matches.
"Tough battle. Congratulations to Lyon who were better than us today. They play good football, physically strong in the duels, fast with the ball and without the ball.
"We had a tough time dealing with it in the first half. Second half we controlled the game better without creating clear-cut chances.
"But then you see how clinical Lyon were from their moments."
On her half-time team talk: "It was 1-0, so we were in the game. Like they had, we need moments as well. We are going to get moments and then how we are going to create it."
"The bigger picture here is that Arsenal have played the best two teams in this competition in two consecutive weeks and they've got just one point out of the two games.
"You have to admit the draw was very tough on them to get both Barcelona and Lyon, but it's also a harsh reality check.
"This Arsenal team won the Champions League just 18 months ago. Now, they're not quite up there with the European elites. Can they get back there anytime soon?"
"I like Renee but there has to come a time [when we question] why is it that all the players look out of form? Apart from Alessia Russo, how many of those players are actually performing?
"There has to come a point where you have to start questioning Renee. As much as I like Renee and everything she's done.
"Not to compare the two, but it feels like Michael Carrick at Man Utd where you feel like someone has taken the team so far but now what?
"We're all waiting for Arsenal to kick on. That tonight disappointed me because it looked flat."

Brighton fans were calling for Fabian Hurzeler to be sacked in February, but a subtle change in approach has the Seagulls among Premier League title contenders; watch Hull vs Brighton live on Sky Sports Premier League and Main Event on Super Sunday; kick-off 2pm
Graham Potter set the tone. Roberto De Zerbi raised expectations. Fabian Hurzeler is blowing both out of the water.
There was scepticism when the German came in at the Amex in 2024 as the youngest permanent head coach in the English top flight. Nearly two and a half years on, that all looks rather silly.
The Seagulls went into the international break perched rather comfortably in second. Paul Merson said in October that if they could beat Liverpool at Anfield and Manchester City at the Etihad, Hurzeler's side would truly be in the title race. They lost on Merseyside, but stunned City in a 1-0 victory .
A 50 per cent return is more than respectable from those two trips. Stay in the hunt throughout Christmas, and there is no doubt that Brighton would have to be viewed as a championship contender.
It's an unbelievable statement, especially considering where Hurzeler found himself earlier this year.
An eight-game winless run throughout January and February heaped pressure on the German and even saw him at times booed by the Amex faithful.
"It's the hardest moment [of my career] but it's also the moment where I learn the most and I will grow the most," Hurzeler emphasised after a 1-0 defeat at home to Crystal Palace in the midst of that torrid streak.
Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player
Learn and grow he most certainly did. But in what way has that been the case?
Likened to Jurgen Klopp when he first arrived by former Liverpool midfielder James Milner, Hurzeler's Brighton have actually adopted less of a 'heavy-metal' style this season.
While their distance covered per game is similar to that of last term, their intensity actually seems to be down, averaging far fewer sprints than previously. This isn't a case of Brighton getting lazy, though.
Instead, they are picking and choosing their moments. Setting traps rather than flying around the pitch. The result is a far more efficient performance out of possession. Their interception figures are around the same as they were last season (8.4 per game vs 8.3), and they are forcing more high turnovers.
Thanks to that, Brighton are seeing much more of the ball - only Arsenal, Manchester City and Spurs have a higher possession percentage in the Premier League. Their build-up play is also far less direct and transitional, as the Seagulls have managed more than three extra 10+ passing sequences per game than last season.
They are by no means playing tiki-taka football, but what they are doing is trying to set the tempo on the ball as opposed to off it.
This effects both ends of the pitch. They are already three clean sheets away from matching their Premier League total from last season. They have close to four more shots a game and average slightly over one extra goal.
If there needed to be any more evidence of how the change of approach has worked wonders for Hurzeler all you have to do is look at how Brighton fared when they last faced Crystal Palace.
Just 252 days after "the hardest moment" of his career, he exacts devastating revenge with a 5-0 thrashing of the Eagles. He even had fans pleading for him to stay after being linked with the Manchester United job. Going from hearing your own supporters sing 'sacked in the morning' to that is some turnaround.
Given that Hurzeler was only 31 when appointed, his ideas and tactics were bound to mature over time. Everyone slows down in their old age, right? Admittedly, 33 is far from old, but those two years have certainly given the Texas-born coach more wisdom to play with.
With that, his side now have a new-found sense of control. It has raised the club's stock. It has raised their coach's stock.
Over the last 12-18 months especially, the idea that the work done off the ball is more crucial to success than what is done on it has become more at the forefront of everyone's mind. The famous counter to that is: the best form of defence is attack.
Hurzeler appears to have found a happy medium between those two ideologies. One that still sees his players adopt a modern high press, but now focuses on locking things up defensively by patrolling games on the ball.
The balance is working perfectly. Whether it can be sustained to produce something truly remarkable is anyone's guess. But that shouldn't stop Brighton fans daring to entertain delusions of grandeur.
Europe? Champions League? A Premier League title? The further up you go, the less realistic it feels to say. Yet, from adversity, Hurzeler has Brighton playing in a way that makes it hard to definitively rule them out of the running for any of it.

Başakşehir Fatih Terim Stadı'ndaki karşılaşma saat 16.00'da başlayacak. Mücadeleyi hakem Ali Şansalan yönetecek.
Sarı-kırmızılı ekip, son 4 sezonda şampiyon olduğu Süper Lig'de bu sezon 11 müsabakada 9 galibiyet, birer beraberlik ve yenilgi yaşadı. Geride kalan bölümde 28 puan toplayan Galatasaray haftaya lider girdi.
Geride kalan 11 maçta 2 galibiyet, 1 beraberlik ve 8 mağlubiyeti bulunan Samsunspor ise 7 puanla 17. sırada yer aldı.
Galatasaray'da yarınki maç öncesi önemli eksikler bulunuyor.
Sol dizinden operasyon geçiren Nijeryalı Victor Osimhen ile sağ üst arka adale grubunda zorlanma ve kanama tespit edilen Portekizli Rafael Leao, Samsunspor karşısında forma giyemeyecek.
Ayrıca milli takımlarında sakatlık yaşayan Macar Roland Sallai, Rus Aleksey Batrakov ile Kolombiyalı Davinson Sanchez'in durumu maç günü belli olacak.
Öte yandan sağ omuz eklem kapsülünde hafif gerilme tespit edilen Uğurcan Çakır, sarı-kırmızılı takımla çalışmalara başladı. Milli file bekçisi, teknik direktör Okan Buruk'un şans vermesi halinde Samsunspor karşısında forma giyebilir.
Sarı-kırmızılı ekipte 3 futbolcu sarı kart sınırında bulunuyor.
Sezonun geride kalan bölümünde üçer sarı kartı bulunan Davinson Sanchez ve Roland Sallai, yarın oynamaları ve sarı kart görmeleri halinde cezalı duruma düşecek.

Galatasaray, kulüp tarihinin ligdeki iç saha yenilmezlik rekorunu kırmak için sahaya çıkacak.
Ligdeki son 41 iç saha maçında 33 galibiyet ve 8 beraberlik yaşayan sarı-kırmızılı takım, Samsunspor karşısında kaybetmemesi halinde sahasındaki namağlup serisini 42 müsabakaya çıkararak rekor kıracak.
Galatasaray, çıktığı son 6 resmi karşılaşmayı galip tamamladı.
Resmi maçlardaki son yenilgisini UEFA Şampiyonlar Ligi'nin 2. haftasında sahasında İspanya temsilcisi Barcelona karşısında yaşayan sarı-kırmızılı ekip, sonrasında Süper Lig'de 4, Avrupa'da ise 2 maçta puan kaybı yaşamadı.

Alman teknik direktör Bernd Storck yönetimindeki kırmızı-siyahlılar, bu sezon iç sahada oynadığı 6 lig maçında 2'şer galibiyet, beraberlik ve mağlubiyet yaşadı.
Gençlerbirliği, ligin ikinci haftasında deplasmanda Göztepe'yi 1-0 mağlup ettiği karşılaşmanın dışında ligdeki tüm puanlarını Eryaman Stadı'nda topladı.
Başkent ekibi, Gaziantep FK'yi konuk ettiği son 3 Süper Lig maçında 2 galibiyet ve 1 beraberlik elde etti.
Geçen sezon iki dönemde Gençlerbirliği'ni çalıştıran teknik direktör Volkan Demirel, yeni takımı Gaziantep FK'nin başındaki ilk maçına başkentte çıkacak.
Ligde geride kalan 11 haftada 2 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 7 mağlubiyet yaşayan Gaziantep FK, topladığı 8 puanla 16. sırada bulunuyor.
Gaziantep FK'nin hafta başında anlaştığı teknik direktör Volkan Demirel, daha önceki cezası nedeniyle Gaziantep temsilcisindeki ilk maçında kulübede olamayacak.
Ligdeki son 6 maçını kaybeden Gaziantep ekibinde sakatlıkları bulunan Kacper Tobiasz ve Fuat Bavuk'un karşılaşmada forma giymesi beklenmiyor.
Gaziantep FK ile Gençlerbirliği, Süper Lig'de 7. kez karşı karşıya gelecek.
İki takım arasında ligde daha önce oynanan 6 karşılaşmanın 3'ünü Gaziantep FK, 2'sini Gençlerbirliği kazanırken, bir mücadele beraberlikle sonuçlandı.
Söz konusu maçlarda Gaziantep temsilcisi 10, başkent ekibi ise 7 gol kaydetti.
Geçen sezon Gaziantep'te oynanan karşılaşmayı kırmızı-siyahlılar 2-1 kazanırken, Ankara'daki mücadeleden aynı skorla Gençlerbirliği galip ayrılmıştı.

Ligde iki takımın karşı karşıya geldiği 42 maçta, sarı-lacivertlilerin üstünlüğü bulunuyor. Fenerbahçe rakibini 22 kez mağlup ederken 13 müsabaka beraberlikle sonuçlandı. Körfez ekibi, 7 kez kazanan taraf oldu.
Sarı-lacivertliler, söz konusu maçlarda rakip fileleri 76 kez havalandırırken, Kocaelispor 33 gol sevinci yaşadı.
İki takımın Kocaeli'deki puan mücadelelerinde Fenerbahçe 9 galibiyet aldı. Ev sahibi takım 7 kez kazanırken 5 müsabaka berabere sonuçlandı.
Fenerbahçe, söz konusu maçlarda rakip fileleri 32 kez havalandırdı, kalesinde 24 gol gördü.
İki ekibin geçen sezon Kocaeli'de oynadığı lig maçını Fenerbahçe 2-0 kazanmıştı.
Fenerbahçe ile Kocaelispor arasında oynanan müsabakalar, farklı skorlara da sahne oldu.
İki takım arasında oynanan lig maçlarında sarı-lacivertliler, rakibini tam 6 kez 4 farkla mağlup etmeyi başardı.
Fenerbahçe, 2000-2001'de hem içeride hem de dışarıda 4-0 galip gelirken 1995-1996 ve 1992-1993 sezonlarında da aynı skorla kazanmayı bildi.
Sarı-lacivertliler, 1994-1995 ve 1981-1982 sezonlarında da rakibini 5-1 mağlup etti.
İki takım arasındaki en gollü maç ise 1981-1982 sezonunda Kocaeli'de oynandı. Fenerbahçe bu maçtan 4-3'lük skorla galip ayrıldı.

Diyarbakır Stadı'nda saat 16.00'da başlayacak karşılaşmayı hakem Ümit Öztürk yönetecek.
Ligde geride kalan 11 haftada 4 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 5 mağlubiyet alan yeşil-mavililer, 14 puanla 11. sırada yer alıyor. Milli maç arası öncesinde sahasında Erzurumspor FK'yi 2-1 yenerek bu sezon taraftarı önündeki ilk galibiyetini alan Karadeniz ekibi, Diyarbakır deplasmanından galibiyetle dönmek istiyor.
Çaykur Rizespor, bu sezon deplasmanda oynadığı 6 maçta 3 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 1 mağlubiyet aldı. Dış sahada 11 puan toplayan yeşil-mavililer, bu karşılaşmalarda rakip fileleri 8 kez havalandırırken kalesinde 5 gol gördü.
Ev sahibi Amed Sportif Faaliyetler ise ligde, 7 galibiyet, 2 beraberlik ve 2 mağlubiyetle 23 puan topladı.
Çaykur Rizespor ile Amed Sportif Faaliyetler, yarın Süper Lig'de ilk kez karşı karşıya gelecek.
Daha önce Türkiye Kupası'nda iki kez karşılaşan ekiplerden Çaykur Rizespor, 8 Ocak 2008'de Rize'de oynanan maçı 2-1 kazandı. Amed Sportif Faaliyetler ise 2 Ekim 2012'de Diyarbakır'da oynanan karşılaşmadan ise 1-0 galip ayrıldı.
